sql: WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank or missing)') AS hand FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count FROM winners GROUP BY hand) SELECT hand, winner_count, winner_count * 1.0 / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts ORDER BY hand

sql: WITH awards_by_hand AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_records FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')) SELECT batting_hand, award_records, award_records * 1.0 / SUM(award_records) OVER () AS share FROM awards_by_hand ORDER BY batting_hand

WITH color_amounts AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), color_metrics AS (SELECT invoiced_amount, invoiced_amount / SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS share, AVG(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS average_per_color FROM color_amounts) SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(invoiced_amount - average_per_color) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average FROM color_metrics WHERE invoiced_amount > average_per_color

sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(li.product_quantity AS INTEGER)), 0) AS quantity FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS li JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = li.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_per_color, SUM(quantity) AS overall_quantity FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(ct.quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(1.0 * ct.quantity / NULLIF(s.overall_quantity, 0)) AS average_share, AVG(ct.quantity - s.average_per_color) AS average_excess FROM color_totals AS ct CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE ct.quantity > s.average_per_color

WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(rt.payment_total - b.avg_payment_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM rental_totals rt CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE rt.payment_total > b.avg_payment_total GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id

sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(rt.payment_total - o.avg_payment_total) AS avg_amount_above_overall FROM rental_totals AS rt CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rt.payment_total > o.avg_payment_total GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(NULLIF(TRIM(ili.product_quantity), '') * 1.0) AS average_quantity, AVG(1.0 * (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY CASE WHEN average_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average_quantity DESC) AS color_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_quantity, average_ratio, color_rank FROM ranked WHERE color_rank <= 3

sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity IS NULL, avg_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, quantity_rank FROM ranked WHERE quantity_rank <= 3

WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS cross_region_avg FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - b.cross_region_avg) AS avg_amount_above_cross_region_avg FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE r.avg_amount > b.cross_region_avg

sql: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS cross_region_mean FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS mean_regional_average, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - b.cross_region_mean) AS mean_excess_amount FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.avg_amount > b.cross_region_mean;

WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), album_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mean_rate) AS average_amount_above_mean FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN album_mean AS m WHERE a.rate > m.mean_rate;

sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(a.rate - o.mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.rate > o.mean_rate;

WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average FROM name_averages) SELECT n.event_name, n.average_amount, n.average_amount - o.mean_average AS amount_above_mean, n.average_amount / o.mean_average AS ratio_to_mean FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.average_amount > o.mean_average

sql: WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS overall_average FROM name_averages), kept AS (SELECT n.event_name, n.average_budgeted_amount, o.overall_average FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.average_budgeted_amount > o.overall_average) SELECT event_name, average_budgeted_amount, average_budgeted_amount - overall_average AS difference_from_overall_average, average_budgeted_amount / (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) FROM kept) AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept;

WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS value FROM event_ratios) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / NULLIF(a.value, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios AS e CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), state_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS invoice_share, AVG(1.0 * invoice_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count - average_count) AS average_invoices_above_average FROM state_metrics WHERE invoice_count > average_count;

WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, average_unit_price - (SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) FROM invoice_averages) AS deviation_from_overall FROM invoice_averages), comparisons AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation_from_overall, deviation_from_overall - AVG(deviation_from_overall) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_average FROM deviations) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation_from_overall, deviation_minus_country_average FROM comparisons ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average IS NULL, deviation_minus_country_average DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 10;

WITH status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM status_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_excess_share FROM status_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share;

sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), shares AS (SELECT gender, invoice_count, invoice_count * 1.0 / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts), compared AS (SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH status_avg AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS pulse_avg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS mean_avg FROM status_avg), first_kept AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.pulse_avg FROM status_avg AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE a.pulse_avg > m.mean_avg), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS mean_avg FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(k.pulse_avg) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.pulse_avg - m1.mean_avg) AS avg_excess_first_mean, AVG(k.pulse_avg - m2.mean_avg) AS avg_excess_second_mean FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m1 CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m2 WHERE k.pulse_avg > m2.mean_avg
