sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t INNER JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS match_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_matches, AVG(g.match_count - b.avg_match_count) AS average_excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.match_count > b.avg_match_count

WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS fee_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_fee_count FROM fee_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(g.fee_count) AS total_fee_count, AVG(g.fee_count - a.avg_fee_count) AS average_count_excess FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_average AS a WHERE g.fee_count > a.avg_fee_count;

WITH entries AS (SELECT c.country, cs.wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM entries GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM entries), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(a.avg_wins - g.avg_wins) AS mean_above_group FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.avg_wins
alternatives: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM country_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(a.avg_wins - g.avg_wins) AS mean_above_group FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.avg_wins

sql: WITH standings_with_previous AS (SELECT cs.raceId, cs.wins, COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId), 0) AS previous_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(s.wins - s.previous_wins) AS average_wins FROM standings_with_previous AS s JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = s.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), all_country_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM country_averages), above_all AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins, ca.average_wins - m.mean_wins AS excess_over_all FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_country_mean AS m WHERE ca.average_wins > m.mean_wins), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM above_all), final_countries AS (SELECT a.average_wins, a.excess_over_all, a.average_wins - m.mean_wins AS excess_over_above_average FROM above_all AS a CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS m WHERE a.average_wins > m.mean_wins) SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average_wins, AVG(excess_over_all) AS mean_excess_over_all, AVG(excess_over_above_average) AS mean_excess_over_above_average FROM final_countries;

WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), rep_stats AS (SELECT City, customer_count, AVG(customer_count * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average, SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS overall_customer_total FROM rep_counts) SELECT City AS city, SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_above_city_average, AVG(customer_count * 1.0 / overall_customer_total) AS average_share_of_overall_customers FROM rep_stats WHERE customer_count > city_average GROUP BY City;

WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), compared AS (SELECT City, customer_count, AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average, SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS matched_customer_total FROM rep_counts) SELECT City, SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_excess, AVG(1.0 * customer_count / matched_customer_total) AS average_share FROM compared WHERE customer_count > city_average GROUP BY City;

WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), comparisons AS (SELECT transref, ordertypedist, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short_interest / NULLIF(AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages) SELECT transref, ordertypedist, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, short_interest_ratio FROM comparisons ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref), transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM matched GROUP BY transref, ordertypedist), mix_averages AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS mix_avg_short_interest FROM matched GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ta.transref, ta.ordertypedist, ta.avg_short_interest, ta.avg_option_volume_ratio, ta.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(ma.mix_avg_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages AS ta JOIN mix_averages AS ma ON ta.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ma.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT t.transreg AS transaction_reference, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), compared AS (SELECT transaction_reference, order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short_interest / NULLIF(AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages) SELECT transaction_reference, order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, short_interest_ratio FROM compared ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_spend FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total, COALESCE(SUM(l.expense_count), 0) AS expense_count, AVG(l.total_cost - b.average_spend) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE l.total_cost > b.average_spend
alternatives: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_spend FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total, COALESCE(SUM(l.expense_count), 0) AS expense_count, AVG(l.total_cost - b.average_spend) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE l.total_cost > b.average_spend

sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(lt.total_cost) AS avg_above_average_total, COALESCE(SUM(lt.expense_count), 0) AS total_expense_count, AVG(lt.total_cost - b.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM line_totals AS lt CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE lt.total_cost > b.avg_total;

SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageTrackPrice, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS PriceRatio FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY PriceRatio IS NULL, PriceRatio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_price) AS baseline_price FROM media_averages), ratios AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.average_price, m.average_price / NULLIF(b.baseline_price, 0) AS ratio FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b) SELECT MediaTypeId, average_price, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC, MediaTypeId LIMIT 10

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS fielding_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count, AVG(fielding_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.fielding_count, h.fielding_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share, h.fielding_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.fielding_count > t.average_count
alternatives: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS fielding_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count, AVG(fielding_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.fielding_count, h.fielding_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share, h.fielding_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.fielding_count > t.average_count

sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS fielding_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), hand_stats AS (SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, SUM(fielding_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(fielding_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, 1.0 * fielding_count / total_count AS share, fielding_count - average_count AS above_average FROM hand_stats WHERE fielding_count > average_count

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, city_id LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count - AVG(address_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, city_id LIMIT 10

sql: SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS count_divided_by_city_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS city_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC LIMIT 10

WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute, AVG(gb_per_minute - all_operator_gb_per_minute) AS average_excess_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE gb_per_minute > all_operator_gb_per_minute;
alternatives: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute, AVG(gb_per_minute - all_operator_gb_per_minute) AS average_excess_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE gb_per_minute > all_operator_gb_per_minute;

sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(1.0 * gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.scan_count) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute - a.all_operator_avg) AS avg_margin_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE o.avg_gb_per_minute > a.all_operator_avg;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT batting_hand, appearance_count, 1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM hand_counts;
alternatives: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT batting_hand, appearance_count, 1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM hand_counts;

sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NULL OR p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT bats, appearance_count, appearance_count * 1.0 / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, appearance_count * 1.0 / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM hand_counts

WITH matched AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref WHERE s.entrystat IS NOT NULL) SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temperature, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_image_count, AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM matched) AS image_count_vs_overall FROM matched GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat;

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS status, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temperature, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_images FROM scanenvironment AS e INNER JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT status, avg_ambient_temperature, avg_images, avg_images - AVG(avg_images) OVER () AS image_average_difference FROM status_averages

WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - b.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.rate > b.average_rate;
alternatives: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - b.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.rate > b.average_rate;

sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT r.media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate;

WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts), compared AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share_above_average > 0 ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), station_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), ranked AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average FROM station_shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, above_average FROM ranked WHERE above_average > 0 ORDER BY above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx::numeric / s.boxz::numeric) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0 GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM compared WHERE margin > 0 ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx::numeric) / NULLIF(AVG(s.boxz::numeric), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0 GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin FROM compared WHERE margin > 0 ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM compared WHERE excess > 0 ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST, project_id LIMIT 10;

WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_name_totals) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS combined_total_points, AVG(t.avg_laps) AS average_laps_completed, AVG(t.total_points - o.avg_total) AS average_excess_points FROM race_name_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.total_points > o.avg_total
alternatives: WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_name_totals), qualifying_names AS (SELECT t.name, t.total_points, t.total_points - o.avg_total AS excess_points FROM race_name_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.total_points > o.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM qualifying_names) AS combined_total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(excess_points) FROM qualifying_names) AS average_excess_points FROM qualifying_names AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.name = q.name JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId

sql: WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total FROM race_name_totals) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS sum_points, AVG(t.average_laps) AS average_laps, AVG(t.total_points - b.average_total) AS average_excess FROM race_name_totals AS t CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE t.total_points > b.average_total;

WITH site_metrics AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_metrics AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio FROM site_metrics GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT sm.insurstat, AVG(sm.site_ratio) AS above_average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS above_average_site_count, SUM(sm.mesh_count) AS above_average_mesh_count, AVG(sm.site_ratio - st.status_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio FROM site_metrics AS sm JOIN status_metrics AS st ON st.insurstat = sm.insurstat WHERE sm.site_ratio > st.status_ratio GROUP BY sm.insurstat

WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_record_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), compared AS (SELECT insurstat, site_ratio, AVG(site_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_avg FROM site_ratios) SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS kept_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count, AVG(site_ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM compared WHERE site_ratio > status_avg GROUP BY insurstat

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS alb_tp, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_pt) AS mean_aptt_pt FROM sex_averages) SELECT AVG(s.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_tp, AVG(s.aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt, AVG(s.aptt_pt - m.mean_aptt_pt) AS avg_excess_aptt_pt FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE s.aptt_pt > m.mean_aptt_pt;
alternatives: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) - AVG(l.TP) AS alb_tp, AVG(l.APTT) - AVG(l.PT) AS aptt_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_pt) AS mean_aptt_pt FROM sex_averages) SELECT AVG(s.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_tp, AVG(s.aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt, AVG(s.aptt_pt - m.mean_aptt_pt) AS avg_excess_aptt_pt FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE s.aptt_pt > m.mean_aptt_pt;

sql: WITH patient_figures AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) - AVG(l.TP) AS alb_minus_tp, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_figures AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_minus_tp) AS alb_minus_tp, AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM patient_figures GROUP BY SEX), sex_mean AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS mean_aptt_minus_pt FROM sex_figures) SELECT AVG(s.alb_minus_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt - m.mean_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_excess FROM sex_figures AS s CROSS JOIN sex_mean AS m WHERE s.aptt_minus_pt > m.mean_aptt_minus_pt

WITH account_totals AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_transaction_amount, transaction_count, CAST(total_transaction_amount AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(total_transaction_amount) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_all_transaction_amounts FROM account_totals ORDER BY fraction_of_all_transaction_amounts DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;

WITH account_flows AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_flow, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, net_flow, transaction_count, net_flow * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(net_flow) OVER (), 0) AS net_flow_share FROM account_flows ORDER BY net_flow_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, CAST(number_of_orders AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM order_counts), compared AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS gap_above_average FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, gap_above_average FROM compared WHERE gap_above_average > 0 ORDER BY (gap_above_average IS NULL), gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, CAST(number_of_orders AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM order_counts), compared AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS gap_above_average FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, gap_above_average FROM compared WHERE gap_above_average > 0 ORDER BY (gap_above_average IS NULL), gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c.gender), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), gender_totals AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS total_gender_orders FROM customer_orders), customer_shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, 1.0 * number_of_orders / NULLIF(total_gender_orders, 0) AS share FROM gender_totals), compared AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM customer_shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, share - average_share AS gap_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY CASE WHEN share - average_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT f.traitregistry, f.zoneref, f.articount, f.articount::numeric / t.artifact_total AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL AND t.artifact_total <> 0), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref, articount, share, share - average_share AS difference_from_average FROM scored WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref, traitregistry LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS articount FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.articount::numeric / t.artifact_total AS share FROM site_counts AS s CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL AND t.artifact_total <> 0), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref, articount, share, share - average_share AS difference_from_average FROM scored WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH artifact_total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), unit_shares AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, sf.articount, CAST(sf.articount AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures AS sf CROSS JOIN artifact_total AS t), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM unit_shares) SELECT u.zoneref AS site_code, u.articount AS artifact_count, u.share, u.share - a.value AS difference_from_average FROM unit_shares AS u CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE record_count > avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, constructorId LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE record_count > avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, constructorId LIMIT 10

sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT counts.constructorId, counts.nationality, counts.record_count, counts.record_count - average_count.avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE counts.record_count > average_count.avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, counts.constructorId LIMIT 10

WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS mean_per_day_rate FROM rating_stats) SELECT AVG(rs.avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(rs.avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(rs.avg_per_day_rate - rm.mean_per_day_rate) AS avg_excess_per_day FROM rating_stats AS rs CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm WHERE rs.avg_per_day_rate > rm.mean_per_day_rate;

WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_stats) SELECT AVG(rs.avg_length) AS avg_rating_length, AVG(rs.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(rs.per_day_price - rm.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price FROM rating_stats AS rs CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm WHERE rs.per_day_price > rm.mean_per_day_price

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_got FROM Laboratory), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS average_got, AVG(RBC) AS average_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT p.ID, p.average_got, p.average_rbc, p.average_got - o.overall_got AS got_difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY got_difference IS NULL, got_difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS mean_patient_got FROM patient_averages) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.mean_patient_got AS got_difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_patient_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_got - o.mean_patient_got) IS NULL ASC, got_difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH district_clients AS (SELECT c.district_id, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c GROUP BY c.district_id), total_clients AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM client) SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS average_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / tc.n) AS average_share_of_all_clients FROM district_clients AS dc JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN total_clients AS tc GROUP BY d.A3;

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM district AS d JOIN client AS c ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), totals AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_clients FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / t.total_clients) AS avg_district_share FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN totals AS t GROUP BY dc.region ORDER BY dc.region;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;
alternatives: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;

sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT award_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_awards, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(ghome) AS total_home_games FROM team GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) AS all_home_games, AVG(total_home_games) AS average_home_games FROM totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.all_home_games, 0) AS share_of_all_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.average_home_games, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH totals AS (SELECT ids.team_id, SUM(h.games) AS total_home_games FROM (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team) AS ids LEFT JOIN home_game AS h ON h.team_id = ids.team_id GROUP BY ids.team_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) AS all_home_games, AVG(total_home_games) AS average_home_games FROM totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.all_home_games, 0) AS share_of_all_home_games, 1.0 * t.total_home_games / NULLIF(o.average_home_games, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), metrics AS (SELECT team_id, total_games, 1.0 * total_games / NULLIF(SUM(total_games) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_all_games, 1.0 * total_games / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game), 0) AS ratio_to_record_average FROM team_totals) SELECT team_id, total_games, fraction_of_all_games, ratio_to_record_average FROM metrics ORDER BY ratio_to_record_average IS NULL, ratio_to_record_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_margin FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate;
alternatives: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_margin FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate;

sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT si.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate;

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), district_shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM district_shares ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), district_shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, account_count * 1.0 / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts), results AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM district_shares) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share_above_average FROM results ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH account_orders AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM account_orders), regional_differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall_average, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average_difference FROM differences) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall_average, difference_from_overall_average - region_average_difference AS excess_over_region_average FROM regional_differences WHERE difference_from_overall_average > region_average_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall_differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, number_of_orders - AVG(number_of_orders) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM order_counts), regional_differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, difference_from_overall_average, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average_difference FROM overall_differences) SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, difference_from_overall_average, difference_from_overall_average - region_average_difference AS excess_over_region_average_difference FROM regional_differences WHERE difference_from_overall_average > region_average_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_average_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), status_averages AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event_averages GROUP BY status), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM event_averages) SELECT s.status, s.avg_remaining, s.avg_overspend_rate, s.avg_remaining / NULLIF(o.avg_remaining, 0) AS remaining_ratio FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), status_averages AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event_averages GROUP BY status) SELECT status, avg_remaining, avg_overspend_rate, avg_remaining / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining) OVER (), 0) AS relative_avg_remaining FROM status_averages;

WITH event_rates AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate FROM event_rates GROUP BY type) SELECT type, average_spending_rate, average_spending_rate / (SELECT AVG(average_spending_rate) FROM type_rates) AS relative_spending_rate FROM type_rates

WITH event_rates AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate FROM event_rates GROUP BY type) SELECT type, average_spending_rate, average_spending_rate / (SELECT AVG(average_spending_rate) FROM type_rates) AS relative_to_mean_type_rate FROM type_rates

WITH counts_by_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS trade_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(trade_count) AS total_count, AVG(trade_count::numeric) AS average_count FROM counts_by_type) SELECT SUM(c.trade_count) AS combined_count, AVG(c.trade_count::numeric / totals.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.trade_count::numeric - totals.average_count) AS average_amount_above_average FROM counts_by_type c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE c.trade_count > totals.average_count;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tr.tradekind), type_stats AS (SELECT transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_stats WHERE transaction_count > average_count

WITH account_tx AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT 1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS average_count) SELECT account_tx.account_id, account_tx.average_amount, account_tx.transaction_count, account_tx.transaction_count / overall.average_count AS count_ratio FROM account_tx CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH account_tx AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count * 1.0) AS average_count FROM account_tx) SELECT account_tx.account_id, account_tx.average_amount, account_tx.transaction_count, account_tx.transaction_count / overall.average_count AS count_ratio FROM account_tx CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_signed_amount, p.transaction_count, p.transaction_count * 1.0 / o.avg_transaction_count AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;
alternatives: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(ANA) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg FROM per_id) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.mean_avg AS gap FROM per_id AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_avg ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(ANA) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg FROM per_id) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.mean_avg AS gap FROM per_id AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_avg ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS overall_mean FROM group_averages) SELECT g.ID AS patient_id, g.avg_ana, g.avg_ana - o.overall_mean AS excess FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.avg_ana > o.overall_mean ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT c.ID, c.examination_count, CAST(c.examination_count AS REAL) / t.total_examinations AS share_of_total FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_examinations FROM Examination) AS t), compared AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM shares) SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, above_average_share FROM compared WHERE above_average_share > 0 ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, ID LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.ID, COUNT(e.ID) AS examination_count FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID), shares AS (SELECT c.ID, c.examination_count, CAST(c.examination_count AS REAL) / t.total_examinations AS share_of_total FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_examinations FROM Examination) AS t), compared AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM shares) SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, above_average_share FROM compared WHERE above_average_share > 0 ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, ID LIMIT 10

sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_examinations, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM counts) SELECT c.ID, c.examination_count, 1.0 * c.examination_count / t.total_examinations AS fraction, 1.0 * c.examination_count / t.total_examinations - 1.0 / t.group_count AS excess FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE 1.0 * c.examination_count / t.total_examinations > 1.0 / t.group_count ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(o.recordvault AS TEXT) = CAST(f.orderslink AS TEXT)), pair_averages AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS pair_avg FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS overall_avg FROM matched) SELECT AVG(p.pair_avg) AS mean_pair_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.pair_avg - a.overall_avg) AS mean_excess FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE p.pair_avg > a.overall_avg;

WITH pair_rates AS (SELECT o.mktnote, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(o.recordvault AS text) = CAST(f.orderslink AS text) GROUP BY o.mktnote), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS rate FROM pair_rates) SELECT AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.rate) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM pair_rates AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.rate

WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), channel_rates AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees WHERE orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderbase), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_average_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.avg_fee_rate
alternatives: WITH channel_rates AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND o.orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM channel_rates) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_average_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.avg_fee_rate

sql: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS rate FROM linked_fees), channel_rates AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS rate FROM linked_fees WHERE orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(c.rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.rate - b.rate) AS mean_excess_fee_rate FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.rate > b.rate

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN client AS c ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_count, SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_count FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(region_count, 0) AS fraction_of_region, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(overall_count, 0) AS fraction_of_overall FROM totals ORDER BY fraction_of_overall DESC, district_id LIMIT 10;

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(dp.disp_id) AS client_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_total, SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_total FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(region_total, 0) AS region_share, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(overall_total, 0) AS overall_share FROM totals ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id LIMIT 10;

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rented_films FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, rented_films, CAST(rented_films AS DECIMAL(38,20)) / SUM(rented_films) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.rented_films) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - b.average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM rating_shares AS rs CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE rs.share > b.average_share

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), shares AS (SELECT rating, film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), compared AS (SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS hof_count FROM player AS p JOIN hall_of_fame AS h ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), state_average AS (SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.hof_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.hof_count - a.avg_count) AS average_amount_above FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN state_average AS a WHERE s.hof_count > a.avg_count;
alternatives: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.inducted = 'Y' THEN h.player_id END) AS hof_count FROM player AS p JOIN hall_of_fame AS h ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), state_average AS (SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.hof_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.hof_count - a.avg_count) AS average_amount_above FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN state_average AS a WHERE s.hof_count > a.avg_count;

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(h.player_id) AS hof_count FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN hall_of_fame AS h ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), state_average AS (SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.hof_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.hof_count - a.avg_count) AS average_amount_above FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN state_average AS a WHERE s.hof_count > a.avg_count;

sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS ballot_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ballot_count) AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.ballot_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.ballot_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.ballot_count > o.average_count;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(HGB) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_average_hgb FROM Laboratory), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, o.overall_average_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_hgb > o.overall_average_hgb), qualifying_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) AS average_of_qualifying_averages FROM above_average) SELECT a.ID, a.average_hgb, a.average_hgb - a.overall_average_hgb AS above_overall_average, a.average_hgb - q.average_of_qualifying_averages AS above_qualifying_average FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN qualifying_average AS q ORDER BY above_qualifying_average DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(HGB) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) AS overall_average_hgb FROM patient_averages), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, o.overall_average_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_hgb > o.overall_average_hgb), qualifying_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) AS average_of_qualifying_averages FROM above_average) SELECT a.ID, a.average_hgb, a.average_hgb - a.overall_average_hgb AS above_overall_average, a.average_hgb - q.average_of_qualifying_averages AS above_qualifying_average FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN qualifying_average AS q ORDER BY above_qualifying_average DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_hgb FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_hgb) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, avg_hgb - overall_hgb AS above_overall, avg_hgb - AVG(avg_hgb) OVER () AS above_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count::numeric / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts
alternatives: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, match_count, match_count::numeric / SUM(match_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, match_count::numeric / AVG(match_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts

WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count::numeric / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts

sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, risk_margin_records, risk_margin_records::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, risk_margin_records::numeric / AVG(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY scope

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), above_average AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - oa.avg_count AS above_account_average FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), above_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM above_average) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.order_count, aa.above_account_average, aa.order_count - aga.avg_count AS above_above_average FROM above_average aa CROSS JOIN above_group_avg aga ORDER BY above_above_average DESC, aa.account_id LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), above_average AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - oa.avg_count AS above_account_average FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), above_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM above_average) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.order_count, aa.above_account_average, aa.order_count - aga.avg_count AS above_above_average FROM above_average aa CROSS JOIN above_group_avg aga ORDER BY above_above_average DESC, aa.account_id LIMIT 10

sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oa.avg_count FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.order_count - k.avg_count AS above_overall_average, k.order_count - ka.avg_count AS above_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), compared AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
alternatives: WITH tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), compared AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT status, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT status, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT status, record_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow

SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow

WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT total_amount, 1.0 * total_amount / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM member_totals), compared AS (SELECT total_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
alternatives: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT total_amount, 1.0 * total_amount / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM member_totals), compared AS (SELECT total_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

sql: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT member_amount, 1.0 * member_amount / SUM(member_amount) OVER () AS share FROM member_totals), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - threshold.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN threshold WHERE share > threshold.average_share

WITH frequency_averages AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS signed_average, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(signed_average) AS signed_mean FROM frequency_averages) SELECT AVG(f.signed_average) AS average_signed_amount, AVG(f.balance_average) AS average_balance, AVG(f.signed_average - m.signed_mean) AS average_excess FROM frequency_averages AS f CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE f.signed_average > m.signed_mean;

WITH frequency_averages AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount FROM frequency_averages) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(f.avg_balance) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.avg_signed_amount - m.mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess FROM frequency_averages AS f CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE f.avg_signed_amount > m.mean_signed_amount;

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS order_avg FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS overall_avg FROM orderexecutions), above_overall AS (SELECT p.order_avg, p.order_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess_overall FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.order_avg > o.overall_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_avg) AS second_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.order_avg) AS average_order_avg, AVG(a.excess_overall) AS average_excess_overall, AVG(a.order_avg - g.second_avg) AS average_excess_second FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN group_avg g WHERE a.order_avg > g.second_avg;
alternatives: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS order_avg FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_avg) AS overall_avg FROM per_order), above_overall AS (SELECT p.order_avg, p.order_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess_overall FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.order_avg > o.overall_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_avg) AS second_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.order_avg) AS average_order_avg, AVG(a.excess_overall) AS average_excess_overall, AVG(a.order_avg - g.second_avg) AS average_excess_second FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN group_avg g WHERE a.order_avg > g.second_avg;

sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_cohort AS (SELECT p.avg_unfilled, b.benchmark AS first_benchmark FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_unfilled > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark FROM first_cohort) SELECT AVG(c.avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled, AVG(c.avg_unfilled - c.first_benchmark) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(c.avg_unfilled - s.benchmark) AS avg_excess_second FROM first_cohort c CROSS JOIN second_benchmark s WHERE c.avg_unfilled > s.benchmark;

SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS account_share FROM account GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY account_share DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), ranked AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY account_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, account_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, district_id;

WITH observatory_shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM observatory_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.telescope_count), 0) AS combined_telescopes, AVG(o.share) AS average_share, AVG(o.share - a.share) AS average_excess_share FROM observatory_shares AS o CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE o.share > a.share;

WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share_of_total FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, major_id LIMIT 10
alternatives: SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) AS share_of_total FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, major_id LIMIT 10

sql: SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS fraction_of_members FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY fraction_of_members DESC, major_id ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), cross_patient AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - c.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN cross_patient AS c WHERE p.ratio > c.avg_ratio
alternatives: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HGB END) / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HCT END), 0) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), cross_patient AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - c.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN cross_patient AS c WHERE p.ratio > c.avg_ratio

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY c.state), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college) SELECT sc.state, sc.record_count, 1.0 * sc.record_count / total.record_count AS share FROM state_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN total ORDER BY sc.state

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), reference AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf, r.overall_avg FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN reference r WHERE r.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_modelconf > r.overall_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - q.overall_avg AS above_average_by, q.avg_modelconf / m.mean_qualifying_avg AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean m WHERE m.mean_qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL

sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS baseline_avg FROM status_averages), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, b.baseline_avg FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_avg AS above_baseline, q.avg_modelconf / m.qualifying_avg AS relative_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean m WHERE q.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL

WITH media_rates AS (SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track AS t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms - b.avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_rate_above_average FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > b.avg_bytes_per_ms
alternatives: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track AS t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms - b.avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_rate_above_average FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > b.avg_bytes_per_ms

sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_byte_rate) AS cross_media_rate FROM media_averages) SELECT AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.avg_byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.avg_byte_rate - o.cross_media_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.avg_byte_rate > o.cross_media_rate;

WITH media_figures AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms / NULLIF(AVG(bytes_per_ms) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_media_type_average FROM media_figures
