sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / NULLIF(AVG(rate) OVER (), 0) AS rate_relative_to_mean FROM media_rates

WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), first_cut AS (SELECT ac.actor_count, fa.avg_count AS avg_first FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN first_average AS fa WHERE ac.actor_count > fa.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM first_cut), final_cut AS (SELECT fc.actor_count, fc.avg_first, sa.avg_count AS avg_second FROM first_cut AS fc CROSS JOIN second_average AS sa WHERE fc.actor_count > sa.avg_count) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actor_count), 0) AS total_actor_count, AVG(actor_count - avg_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(actor_count - avg_second) AS avg_excess_second FROM final_cut
alternatives: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT fa.film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor AS fa GROUP BY fa.film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), first_cut AS (SELECT ac.actor_count, fa.avg_count AS avg_first FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN first_average AS fa WHERE ac.actor_count > fa.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM first_cut), final_cut AS (SELECT fc.actor_count, fc.avg_first, sa.avg_count AS avg_second FROM first_cut AS fc CROSS JOIN second_average AS sa WHERE fc.actor_count > sa.avg_count) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actor_count), 0) AS total_actor_count, AVG(actor_count - avg_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(actor_count - avg_second) AS avg_excess_second FROM final_cut

sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS mean_count FROM actor_counts), above_first AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - a.mean_count AS first_excess FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN first_average AS a WHERE ac.actor_count > a.mean_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS mean_count FROM above_first), above_second AS (SELECT af.actor_count, af.first_excess, af.actor_count - a.mean_count AS second_excess FROM above_first AS af CROSS JOIN second_average AS a WHERE af.actor_count > a.mean_count) SELECT SUM(actor_count) AS total_actor_count, AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess FROM above_second;

SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) AS attendance_share FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position ORDER BY attendance_share DESC, m.member_id LIMIT 10;

WITH member_counts AS (SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM member_counts ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId ORDER BY share DESC, circuitId LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_stats AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, average_round, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS race_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY race_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM circuit_stats) SELECT circuitId, average_round, race_count, race_share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY race_share DESC, circuitId;

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / b.amount) AS average_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.type IS NOT NULL AND b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, average_ratio, ABS(average_ratio - AVG(average_ratio) OVER ()) AS distance_from_type_mean FROM type_averages ORDER BY event_type

WITH type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM type_rates) SELECT tr.Name, tr.rate, tr.track_count, tr.rate - o.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM type_rates AS tr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE tr.rate > o.average_rate

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS films_in_stock FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(films_in_stock) AS avg_films_in_stock FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.films_in_stock) AS total_films_in_stock, AVG(rc.films_in_stock - ra.avg_films_in_stock) AS avg_above_rating_average FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.films_in_stock > ra.avg_films_in_stock

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(copies) AS avg_copies FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.copies) AS total_copies, AVG(rc.copies - ra.avg_copies) AS avg_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.copies > ra.avg_copies

WITH status_rates AS (SELECT t.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry GROUP BY t.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS all_status_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_count, AVG(sr.rate - o.all_status_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.rate > o.all_status_rate;

sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.site_count) AS average_site_count, AVG(sr.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.rate > o.average_rate;

SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share FROM telescopes AS t GROUP BY t.observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC, t.observstation ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.dealedge), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.order_count) AS total_count, AVG(sc.order_count - sa.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa WHERE sc.order_count > sa.avg_count

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_figures AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), all_region_average AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS average_figure FROM region_figures) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - a.average_figure AS amount_above_average, r.figure / NULLIF(a.average_figure, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM region_figures AS r CROSS JOIN all_region_average AS a WHERE r.figure > a.average_figure

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_figures AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS average_figure FROM region_figures) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - o.average_figure AS amount_above_average, r.figure / o.average_figure AS ratio_to_average FROM region_figures AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.figure > o.average_figure;

SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS conserved_site_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS NUMERIC) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT status, site_count, CAST(site_count AS DECIMAL) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts

WITH tallies AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '')), shares AS (SELECT hand, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies), compared AS (SELECT hand, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(hand, 'Unknown') AS hand, tally, share, share - average_share AS exceeds_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share DESC, hand;

WITH award_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM award_counts) SELECT batting_hand, award_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) ORDER BY share DESC, batting_hand;

sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT AVG(c.player_count) AS avg_count, AVG(1.0 * c.player_count / o.total_count) AS avg_share, AVG(c.player_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM college_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.player_count > o.avg_count;

WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share FROM invoice_counts), compared AS (SELECT invoice_count, invoice_share, AVG(invoice_share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice_count), 0) AS total_number_of_invoices, AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE invoice_share > overall_average_share;

WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM invoice_counts), compared AS (SELECT invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice_count), 0) AS total_number_of_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amount_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg, AVG(balance_avg) AS balance_avg FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS mean_amount_avg FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / o.mean_amount_avg AS amount_avg_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_amount_avg IS NOT NULL AND o.mean_amount_avg <> 0
alternatives: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS amount_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg, AVG(balance_avg) AS balance_avg FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS mean_amount_avg FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / o.mean_amount_avg AS amount_avg_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_amount_avg IS NOT NULL AND o.mean_amount_avg <> 0

sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS amount_average, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_average) AS average_amount, AVG(balance_average) AS average_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_region_amount FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.average_amount, r.average_balance, r.average_amount / o.mean_region_amount AS amount_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_region_amount IS NOT NULL

WITH player_averages AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM player_averages), 0) AS relative_index FROM player_averages), gaps AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, relative_index, relative_index - AVG(relative_index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, relative_index, gap FROM gaps ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC, player_id LIMIT 10;

WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS average_doubles FROM player AS p JOIN batting_postseason AS bp ON bp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), player_indices AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, average_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM player_averages), 0) AS index_value FROM player_averages), hand_averages AS (SELECT bats, AVG(index_value) AS hand_average_index FROM player_indices GROUP BY bats) SELECT pi.player_id, pi.bats, pi.average_doubles, pi.index_value AS "index", pi.index_value - ha.hand_average_index AS index_minus_hand_average FROM player_indices AS pi JOIN hand_averages AS ha ON ha.bats = pi.bats ORDER BY (pi.index_value - ha.hand_average_index) IS NULL, index_minus_hand_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS average_amount FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency), compared AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, average_amount, average_amount / NULLIF(AVG(average_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency), 0) AS ratio FROM account_averages) SELECT account_id, frequency, average_amount, ratio FROM compared ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), per_frequency AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(account_average) AS frequency_average FROM per_account), ratios AS (SELECT p.account_id, p.frequency, p.account_average, p.account_average / NULLIF(f.frequency_average, 0) AS ratio FROM per_account AS p JOIN per_frequency AS f ON f.frequency = p.frequency) SELECT account_id, frequency, account_average, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH funding_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) FILTER (WHERE s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3) FILTER (WHERE s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT *, AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS avg_funding_ratio FROM funding_metrics) SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio, area_to_volume_ratio - avg_funding_ratio AS amount_above_average FROM compared WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > avg_funding_ratio;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendees FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status) SELECT status, attendees, attendees * 1.0 / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), status_shares AS (SELECT conservation_count, conservation_count * 1.0 / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT conservation_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT AVG(conservation_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;

WITH item_quantities AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS quantity FROM Order_Items), overall AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS overall_avg FROM item_quantities), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS order_avg FROM item_quantities GROUP BY order_id) SELECT p.order_id, p.order_avg AS average_quantity, p.order_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.order_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items) SELECT p.order_id, p.average_quantity, p.average_quantity - b.average_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.average_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.average_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10

WITH station_usage AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / SUM(SUM(telescope_count)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM station_usage GROUP BY lunarstage

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM order_counts) SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - ac.avg_order_count AS difference FROM order_counts AS oc JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac ORDER BY difference DESC, oc.account_id LIMIT 10

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), scored AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM order_counts) AS difference FROM order_counts), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) AS place FROM scored) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id;

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film), first_cut AS (SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ra.avg_length > oa.avg_length), first_cut_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM first_cut) SELECT AVG(fc.avg_length) AS mean_length, AVG(fc.avg_length - oa.avg_length) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(fc.avg_length - fm.avg_length) AS mean_above_first_cut FROM first_cut fc CROSS JOIN overall_average oa CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean fm WHERE fc.avg_length > fm.avg_length

WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), shares AS (SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC, manager_id LIMIT 10;

WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, manager_id LIMIT 10;

WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - x.avg_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM town_averages AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.avg_ratio > x.avg_ratio

WITH per_item AS (SELECT c.town_city AS town, ili.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.town_city, ili.order_item_id), per_town AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_item GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_town) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - x.avg_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM per_town AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.avg_ratio > x.avg_ratio

WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM per_type) SELECT AVG(p.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(p.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(p.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_margin FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.rate > o.average_rate;

WITH groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, employee_count * 1.0 / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM groups) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, 1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM shares ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) AS average_count, SUM(type_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.tradekind, c.type_count, c.type_count::numeric / s.total_count AS share_of_total, c.type_count - s.average_count AS above_average_by FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS s WHERE c.type_count > s.average_count
alternatives: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) AS average_count, SUM(type_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.tradekind, c.type_count, c.type_count::numeric / s.total_count AS share_of_total, c.type_count - s.average_count AS above_average_by FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS s WHERE c.type_count > s.average_count

sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS average_count, SUM(trader_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind, p.trader_count, p.trader_count::numeric / totals.total_count AS share_of_total, p.trader_count - totals.average_count AS above_average_by FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.trader_count > totals.average_count

WITH counts AS (SELECT c.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat) SELECT site_reference, insurance_status, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM counts ORDER BY fraction DESC, insurance_status ASC NULLS LAST, site_reference ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat), ranked AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, conservation_count::numeric / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY conservation_count DESC) AS place FROM grouped) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref, insurstat NULLS LAST;

WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS across_rating_avg FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.avg_price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day, AVG(p.avg_price_per_day - b.across_rating_avg) AS avg_amount_above FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_price_per_day > b.across_rating_avg;

WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), across_ratings AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg_per_day FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(pr.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day, AVG(pr.avg_per_day - ar.overall_avg_per_day) AS avg_excess FROM per_rating AS pr CROSS JOIN across_ratings AS ar WHERE pr.avg_per_day > ar.overall_avg_per_day

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS o WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin AS r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.order_count) AS average_count_above_average, AVG(t.order_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE t.order_count > a.average_count;

sql:
WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderspivot, o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan,
         AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_fill
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.recordvault, o.timespan
), ranked AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill,
         AVG(average_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS time_in_force_average,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY average_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill,
       average_fill - time_in_force_average AS amount_above_average,
       fill_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE average_fill > time_in_force_average
  AND fill_rank <= 3;

sql: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) AS avg_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(c.record_count) AS total_record_count, AVG(c.record_count * 1.0 / o.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.record_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM country_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.record_count > o.avg_count
SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS address_fraction FROM address GROUP BY city_id ORDER BY address_fraction DESC, city_id ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction FROM address GROUP BY city_id ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), with_share AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS overall_share FROM per_transaction) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(overall_share) AS average_share FROM with_share GROUP BY tradekind;
alternatives: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advancedbehavior ab WHERE ab.translink = tr.transreg) GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), with_share AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS overall_share FROM per_transaction) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(overall_share) AS average_share FROM with_share GROUP BY tradekind;

sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, td.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS td ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, td.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS transaction_share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count_per_pair, AVG(transaction_share) AS average_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm_diff FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS mean_diff FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / NULLIF(o.mean_diff, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY pa.SEX;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS mean_diff FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_patient_iga_igm_diff, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / NULLIF(om.mean_diff, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE pa.SEX <> '' GROUP BY pa.SEX;

WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT d.driverId, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_records FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId), driver_average AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS average_records FROM driver_counts) SELECT dc.driverId, dc.qualifying_records, 1.0 * dc.qualifying_records / da.average_records AS ratio_to_average FROM driver_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN driver_average AS da ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, dc.driverId ASC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_records FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), driver_average AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS average_records FROM driver_counts) SELECT dc.driverId, dc.qualifying_records, 1.0 * dc.qualifying_records / da.average_records AS ratio_to_average FROM driver_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN driver_average AS da ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, dc.driverId ASC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId) SELECT driverId, qualifying_count, 1.0 * qualifying_count / (SELECT AVG(qualifying_count) FROM driver_counts) AS ratio FROM driver_counts ORDER BY ratio DESC, driverId ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), measured AS (SELECT source, spatial_count, SUM(spatial_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT source, spatial_count AS count, 100.0 * spatial_count / total_count AS share_percent, spatial_count - average_count AS above_average FROM measured WHERE spatial_count > average_count
alternatives: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), measured AS (SELECT source, project_count, SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(project_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT source, project_count AS count, 100.0 * project_count / total_count AS share_percent, project_count - average_count AS above_average FROM measured WHERE project_count > average_count

sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT fundflux, project_count, AVG(project_count * 1.0) OVER () AS average_count, SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT fundflux, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share, project_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM totals WHERE project_count > average_count

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM account_averages) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - o.overall_average AS excess FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.average_amount > o.overall_average ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_average FROM trans) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - o.overall_average AS excess FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.average_amount > o.overall_average ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS average_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_amount FROM account_averages) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - m.mean_amount AS above_mean FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE a.average_amount > m.mean_amount ORDER BY above_mean DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10

WITH college_income AS (SELECT maj.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY maj.college) SELECT ci.college, ci.total_income_amount, 1.0 * ci.total_income_amount / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income), 0) AS fraction_of_total_income FROM college_income AS ci;
alternatives: WITH college_income AS (SELECT maj.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY maj.college) SELECT college, total_income_amount, 1.0 * total_income_amount / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total_income_amount) FROM college_income), 0) AS fraction_of_total_income FROM college_income;

sql: WITH college_income AS (SELECT maj.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major AS maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id WHERE maj.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY maj.college) SELECT college, total_income, 1.0 * total_income / NULLIF(SUM(total_income) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total FROM college_income;

WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination) AS share FROM counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE share > average_share
alternatives: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.ID, COUNT(e.ID) AS record_count FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination), 0) AS share FROM counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE share > average_share

sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), compared AS (SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share

WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.relative_gap, i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.relative_gap, i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.overall_average AS difference_above_average FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average ORDER BY difference_above_average IS NULL, difference_above_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH department_counts AS (SELECT ma.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), shares AS (SELECT income_count, income_count * 1.0 / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT income_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(income_count) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH department_counts AS (SELECT maj.department, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY maj.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark FROM per_order), above_first AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill_size, p.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS first_margin FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark FROM above_first), final_orders AS (SELECT a.avg_fill_size, a.first_margin, a.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS second_margin FROM above_first a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE a.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size, AVG(first_margin) AS avg_first_margin, AVG(second_margin) AS avg_second_margin FROM final_orders

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(NULLIF(fillcount, 0)) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_pass AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_excess FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_pass), final_pass AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.first_excess, f.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS second_excess FROM first_pass f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE f.avg_fill > b.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_per_order_fill, AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess FROM final_pass

WITH examination_sex AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN 'blank' ELSE 'recorded' END AS sex_group, CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END AS sex FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID), by_sex AS (SELECT sex_group, sex, COUNT(*) AS examined_count FROM examination_sex GROUP BY sex_group, sex), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examined_count) AS overall_total, AVG(CAST(examined_count AS REAL)) AS per_sex_average FROM by_sex) SELECT 'sex' AS row_type, b.sex_group, b.sex, b.examined_count, 1.0 * b.examined_count / t.overall_total AS share_of_total, NULL AS average_share, NULL AS average_above_per_sex_average FROM by_sex b CROSS JOIN totals t UNION ALL SELECT 'above_average', NULL, NULL, COALESCE(SUM(b.examined_count), 0), NULL, AVG(1.0 * b.examined_count / t.overall_total), AVG(b.examined_count - t.per_sex_average) FROM by_sex b CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE b.examined_count > t.per_sex_average
alternatives: WITH patient_sex AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN 'blank' ELSE 'recorded' END AS sex_group, CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END AS sex FROM Patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID = p.ID)), by_sex AS (SELECT sex_group, sex, COUNT(*) AS examined_count FROM patient_sex GROUP BY sex_group, sex), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examined_count) AS overall_total, AVG(CAST(examined_count AS REAL)) AS per_sex_average FROM by_sex) SELECT 'sex' AS row_type, b.sex_group, b.sex, b.examined_count, 1.0 * b.examined_count / t.overall_total AS share_of_total, NULL AS average_share, NULL AS average_above_per_sex_average FROM by_sex b CROSS JOIN totals t UNION ALL SELECT 'above_average', NULL, NULL, COALESCE(SUM(b.examined_count), 0), NULL, AVG(1.0 * b.examined_count / t.overall_total), AVG(b.examined_count - t.per_sex_average) FROM by_sex b CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE b.examined_count > t.per_sex_average

sql: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_count, AVG(examination_count * 1.0) AS average_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.examination_count) AS total_examination_count, AVG(sc.examination_count * 1.0 / o.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(sc.examination_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sc.examination_count > o.average_count

SELECT i.film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_all_copies FROM inventory AS i GROUP BY i.film_id ORDER BY share_of_all_copies DESC, i.film_id ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH film_copies AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id), ranked AS (SELECT film_id, copies, copies / SUM(copies) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copies DESC) AS copy_rank FROM film_copies) SELECT film_id, copies, share FROM ranked WHERE copy_rank <= 10 ORDER BY copies DESC, film_id;

WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, CAST(risk_margin_count AS numeric) / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, share, ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS distance_from_average_share FROM shares WHERE timespan IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timespan
alternatives: WITH time_in_force(timespan) AS (VALUES ('IOC'), ('GTC'), ('GTD'), ('FOK')), counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), total AS (SELECT SUM(risk_margin_count) AS overall_count FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT t.timespan, COALESCE(c.risk_margin_count, 0) AS risk_margin_count, CAST(COALESCE(c.risk_margin_count, 0) AS numeric) / NULLIF(total.overall_count, 0) AS share FROM time_in_force AS t LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON c.timespan = t.timespan CROSS JOIN total) SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, share, ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS distance_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan

sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan) SELECT timespan, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () - 1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM counts ORDER BY timespan;

WITH account_orders AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order"), 0) AS share FROM account_orders), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.order_count), 0) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM order_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_amount_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share

WITH total_items AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Order_Items), product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.item_count, 0) AS item_share FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id CROSS JOIN total_items t GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, t.item_count), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM product_stats GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM type_stats

WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(oi.product_quantity * 1.0) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), product_shares AS (SELECT product_type_description, avg_quantity, item_count, COALESCE(item_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(item_count) OVER (), 0), 0) AS item_share FROM product_stats), type_averages AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM product_shares GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(avg_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM type_averages

WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_product_cost END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, AVG(derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT b.link_to_event, AVG(b.spent) AS average_spent, AVG(b.remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(b.remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS remaining_difference FROM budget AS b WHERE b.link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.link_to_event ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS average_spent, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, average_spent, average_remaining, average_remaining - (SELECT AVG(average_remaining) FROM event_averages) AS remaining_difference FROM event_averages ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_avg_remaining FROM per_event) SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_spent, p.avg_remaining, p.avg_remaining - o.mean_avg_remaining AS remaining_above_mean FROM per_event AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY remaining_above_mean IS NULL, remaining_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM grouped) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(b.mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY average_ratio IS NULL, average_ratio DESC) AS event_rank FROM event_ratios) SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank FROM ranked WHERE event_rank <= 3 ORDER BY location, event_rank, event_id;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.location) <> '' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) AS event_rank FROM event_averages) SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank FROM ranked WHERE event_rank <= 3;

WITH currency_averages AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_currency_rebate FROM currency_averages) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rebate) AS mean_average_rebate, AVG(c.avg_relative_gap) AS mean_average_relative_gap, AVG(c.avg_rebate - b.avg_currency_rebate) AS mean_excess_rebate FROM currency_averages AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_rebate > b.avg_currency_rebate;

WITH currency_averages AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_rebate FROM currency_averages) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate, AVG(c.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(c.avg_rebate - b.mean_rebate) AS avg_excess_rebate FROM currency_averages c CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.mean_rebate IS NOT NULL AND c.avg_rebate > b.mean_rebate;

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over FROM budget) SELECT s.event_status, s.average_left_over, s.average_left_over - o.average_left_over AS difference_from_overall FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.average_left_over IS NOT NULL

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status AS status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_difference FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS value FROM status_averages) SELECT s.status, s.average_difference, s.average_difference - b.value AS difference_from_baseline FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL

WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM transaction_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, avg_anlycount - overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept_avg FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST, transref LIMIT 10

WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.avg_anlycount, t.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM transaction_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), results AS (SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, above_kept_avg FROM (SELECT results.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS position FROM results) ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST, transref;

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE c.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, 1.0 * qualifying_count / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS qualifying_share FROM city_counts), city_averages AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_share, AVG(qualifying_share) OVER () AS average_city_share FROM shares) SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_share, qualifying_share - average_city_share AS share_above_average FROM city_averages WHERE qualifying_share > average_city_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, city

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages);

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT sex, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY sex) SELECT sex, avg_alb, avg_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages);

WITH phases AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phases) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth) AS avg_selected_bandwidth, COALESCE(SUM(p.telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescope_count, AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth) AS avg_excess FROM phases AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth;

WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg) AS average_bandwidth_usage, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS telescope_count, AVG(p.phase_avg - m.mean_phase_avg) AS average_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS m WHERE p.phase_avg > m.mean_phase_avg;

WITH country_figures AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS average_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, average_points, average_wins, average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS wins_above_or_below_country_average FROM country_figures ORDER BY country;

WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), totals AS (SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_transaction_count, AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_transaction_count FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(town_transaction_count, 0) AS town_transaction_share, transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(average_transaction_count, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, transaction_count DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.average_wbc, pa.average_ratio AS ratio, pa.average_ratio - om.mean_ratio AS gap FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE pa.average_ratio > om.mean_ratio ORDER BY CASE WHEN pa.average_ratio - om.mean_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, gap DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.patient_id, pa.sex, pa.avg_wbc, pa.ratio, pa.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH major_counts AS (SELECT ma.major_id, ma.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.major_id, ma.department), major_shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), compared AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_average FROM major_shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - department_average AS difference_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > department_average ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > o.overall_avg), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS second_avg FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - o.overall_avg) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - s.second_avg) AS mean_above_second FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > s.second_avg;

WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS amount_spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_share AS (SELECT amount_spent, amount_spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_spend), compared AS (SELECT amount_spent, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM customer_share) SELECT AVG(amount_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share

WITH site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM site_counts), ranked AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM ranked WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10;
