WITH observatory_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM observatory_counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts), differences AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC) AS position FROM differences) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC, observstation;

WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_constructor_points FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entries FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.country, rc.total_constructor_points, rc.entry_count, rc.entry_count - ra.avg_entries AS difference_from_average FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rc.entry_count > ra.avg_entries ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, rc.raceId LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_constructor_points FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entries FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.country, rc.total_constructor_points, rc.entry_count, rc.entry_count - ra.avg_entries AS difference_from_average FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rc.entry_count > ra.avg_entries ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, rc.raceId LIMIT 10

sql: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entry_count FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.country, rc.total_points, rc.entry_count, rc.entry_count - ra.avg_entry_count AS above_average FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rc.entry_count > ra.avg_entry_count ORDER BY above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH category_summary AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category), category_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count FROM category_summary) SELECT AVG(cs.avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(cs.line_count * 1.0) AS avg_budget_lines, AVG(cs.line_count - cb.avg_line_count) AS avg_lines_above_category_average FROM category_summary AS cs CROSS JOIN category_baseline AS cb WHERE cs.line_count > cb.avg_line_count;

WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG(CASE WHEN spent <> 0 AND amount <> 0 THEN 1.0 * (spent - amount) / amount END) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), category_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM category_stats CROSS JOIN category_baseline WHERE line_count > avg_line_count;

WITH customer_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM Orders), scored AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(total_orders, 0) AS share FROM customer_counts CROSS JOIN total) SELECT customer_id, order_count, share FROM scored ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH customer_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM Orders) SELECT customer_id, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / total_orders AS share FROM customer_counts CROSS JOIN total ORDER BY share DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_share FROM customer_orders), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, order_share DESC, customer_id;

WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG((CAST(g AS REAL) - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id), compared AS (SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS wins_above_mean FROM compared WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins ORDER BY wins_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH team_halves AS (SELECT team_id, year, league_id, half, SUM(w) AS wins, SUM(l) AS losses, SUM(g) AS games FROM manager_half WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id, year, league_id, half), team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins, AVG((CAST(games AS REAL) - losses) / NULLIF(losses, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM team_halves GROUP BY team_id), compared AS (SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT team_id, avg_wins, avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS wins_above_mean FROM compared WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins ORDER BY wins_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

sql: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, t.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins AS gap FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_wins > o.mean_avg_wins ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, attendee_count, 1.0 * attendee_count / SUM(attendee_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_city_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(c.attendee_count) AS average_attendees, AVG(c.share) AS average_share, AVG(c.share - b.average_city_share) AS average_excess_share FROM city_shares AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.share > b.average_city_share;
alternatives: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendee_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, attendee_count, 1.0 * attendee_count / SUM(attendee_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_city_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(c.attendee_count) AS average_attendees, AVG(c.share) AS average_share, AVG(c.share - b.average_city_share) AS average_excess_share FROM city_shares AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.share > b.average_city_share;

sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip WHERE z.city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT attendance_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(attendance_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > overall_average_share;

WITH linked AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation FROM linked), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX), ranked AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.avg_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.avg_deviation) SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation AS deviation_from_overall_mean, excess AS above_sex_average_deviation FROM ranked ORDER BY CASE WHEN excess IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH exams AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) FROM exams) AS deviation FROM exams), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.average_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.average_deviation ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern` HAVING COUNT(`aCL IgG`) > 0), cross_pattern AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS avg_of_patterns FROM pattern_averages), above_average AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_acl_igg, p.avg_acl_igg - c.avg_of_patterns AS above_cross_pattern_avg FROM pattern_averages p CROSS JOIN cross_pattern c WHERE p.avg_acl_igg > c.avg_of_patterns) SELECT pattern, avg_acl_igg, above_cross_pattern_avg, ABS(avg_acl_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) FROM above_average)) AS distance_from_above_average_patterns_avg FROM above_average ORDER BY avg_acl_igg DESC, pattern;

WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS average_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_igg) AS mean_average FROM pattern_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.* FROM pattern_averages p CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE p.average_igg > o.mean_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_igg) AS mean_average FROM kept) SELECT k.pattern, k.average_igg, k.average_igg - o.mean_average AS above_overall_mean, ABS(k.average_igg - m.mean_average) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall_mean o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY k.pattern

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget), above_average AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.average_amount, e.average_amount - o.average_amount AS above_overall_by FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.average_amount > o.average_amount) SELECT link_to_event, average_amount, above_overall_by, average_amount - AVG(average_amount) OVER () AS above_average_events_gap FROM above_average ORDER BY above_average_events_gap DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM event_averages), kept AS (SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount, ea.average_amount - o.overall_average AS above_overall FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.average_amount > o.overall_average) SELECT link_to_event, average_amount, above_overall, average_amount - AVG(average_amount) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS group_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.group_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.group_size - b.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN size_baseline AS b WHERE ss.group_size > b.avg_size
alternatives: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0) AS group_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.group_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.group_size - b.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN size_baseline AS b WHERE ss.group_size > b.avg_size

WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS group_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.group_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.group_size - b.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN size_baseline AS b WHERE ss.group_size > b.avg_size

sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(spatial_count) AS avg_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(ss.spatial_count) AS total_spatial_count, AVG(ss.spatial_count - b.avg_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ss.spatial_count > b.avg_count;

WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM player_totals) SELECT SUM(pt.total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(pt.total - o.average_total) AS average_excess FROM player_totals AS pt CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pt.total > o.average_total;

WITH totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT player_id, death_country FROM player WHERE death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(death_country) <> '') AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM totals) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_totals, AVG(t.total - b.average_total) AS average_excess FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.total > b.average_total

WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_timing_ownership, AVG(t.avg_ownership - o.avg_ownership) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM timing_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.avg_ownership
alternatives: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS avg_ownership FROM timing_averages) SELECT AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_timing_ownership, AVG(t.avg_ownership - b.avg_ownership) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM timing_averages t CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE t.avg_ownership > b.avg_ownership

sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM group_averages) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS mean_group_average, AVG(g.group_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_above_baseline FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.group_avg > b.baseline_avg

WITH store_counts AS (SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM store AS s LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM store_counts) SELECT sc.store_id, sc.customer_count, sc.customer_count / NULLIF(t.total_customers, 0) AS share_of_customers, sc.customer_count / NULLIF(t.total_customers / t.store_count, 0) AS multiple_of_average FROM store_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t ORDER BY sc.store_id

WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id) SELECT store_id, customer_count, customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share_of_customers, customer_count / AVG(customer_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM store_counts ORDER BY store_id;

WITH analyzed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tx.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref), type_counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM analyzed_trades GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY tradekind NULLS LAST;
alternatives: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY tradekind NULLS LAST;

WITH analyzed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tx.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL), type_counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM analyzed_trades GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY tradekind;

sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, CAST(analysis_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts

WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.avg_bandwidth_usage AS margin_above_overall FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.avg_bandwidth_usage ORDER BY margin_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes), station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT s.observstation, s.station_avg AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.station_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference_above_overall FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.station_avg > o.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), group_shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM group_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gs.member_count), 0) AS total_members, AVG(gs.share) AS average_share, AVG(gs.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM group_shares AS gs CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE gs.share > b.average_share;

WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), group_shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM group_counts) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(member_count), 0) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM group_shares WHERE share > average_share

WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_points, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS constructor_entries FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_entries, constructor_entries - AVG(constructor_entries) OVER () AS entries_vs_nationality_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;
alternatives: WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultId) AS constructor_entries FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN results AS r ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_entries, constructor_entries - AVG(constructor_entries) OVER () AS entries_vs_nationality_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;

sql: WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_points, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS result_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, result_count, result_count - AVG(result_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;

WITH category_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(NULLIF(TRIM(ili.product_quantity), '')) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS mean_difference FROM category_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(ca.avg_difference) AS average_difference, AVG(ca.avg_difference - om.mean_difference) AS average_excess FROM category_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE ca.avg_difference > om.mean_difference
alternatives: WITH category_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(NULLIF(TRIM(ili.product_quantity), '')) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost - ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS mean_difference FROM category_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(ca.avg_difference) AS average_difference, AVG(ca.avg_difference - om.mean_difference) AS average_excess FROM category_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE ca.avg_difference > om.mean_difference

sql: WITH category_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(ili.product_quantity) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL) END) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)) AS avg_cost_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), category_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference FROM category_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference) AS average_cost_difference, AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference - cm.mean_cost_difference) AS average_excess FROM category_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm WHERE ca.avg_cost_difference > cm.mean_cost_difference;

SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans AS sc INNER JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_price FROM Products), kept_types AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_average FROM type_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.type_average > o.overall_price), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS mean_type_average FROM kept_types) SELECT AVG(k.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(k.type_average - o.overall_price) AS average_above_overall, AVG(k.type_average - m.mean_type_average) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM kept_types AS k CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.type_average > m.mean_type_average

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_average FROM Products HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), kept_types AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_average FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_average > b.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS average_kept_type FROM kept_types) SELECT AVG(k.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(k.type_average - b.overall_average) AS average_above_baseline, AVG(k.type_average - m.average_kept_type) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m LEFT JOIN kept_types k ON k.type_average > m.average_kept_type GROUP BY b.overall_average;
SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS signal_share FROM signals GROUP BY telescref ORDER BY signal_share DESC, telescref LIMIT 10;
SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS fraction FROM signals GROUP BY telescref ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, mix_count::numeric / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), compared AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM mix_shares) SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, mix NULLS LAST;

WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), compared AS (SELECT order_type_mix, transaction_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share FROM shares) SELECT order_type_mix, transaction_count, share, share - baseline_share AS above_baseline FROM compared WHERE share > baseline_share;

WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.project_reference, pr.funding_source, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.rate AS gap_above_benchmark FROM project_rates AS pr CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE pr.rate > b.rate ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.project_reference, pr.funding_source, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.rate AS gap_above_benchmark FROM project_rates AS pr CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE pr.rate > b.rate ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.rate AS excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(f.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_above_group FROM first_group f CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE f.ratio > g.avg_ratio;

sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ratio, p.ratio - o.average_ratio AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(f.above_overall) AS average_above_overall, AVG(f.ratio - s.average_ratio) AS average_above_second FROM first_group f CROSS JOIN second_average s WHERE f.ratio > s.average_ratio;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), compared AS (SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, AVG(avg_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM event_averages) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, avg_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_event_type_average FROM compared WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
alternatives: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), compared AS (SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, AVG(avg_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM event_averages) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_analyst_reports, avg_gap, avg_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_event_type_average FROM compared WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL

sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS avg_event_difference FROM event_averages) SELECT e.event_type, e.avg_analyst_reports, e.avg_ownership_difference, e.avg_ownership_difference - o.avg_event_difference AS difference_from_overall_average FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.avg_event_difference IS NOT NULL

WITH site_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS site_avg FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), status_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg) AS status_avg FROM site_averages WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS overall_avg FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref) SELECT AVG(sa.site_avg) AS average_face_count, AVG(sa.site_avg - oa.overall_avg) AS average_above_overall, AVG(sa.site_avg - sta.status_avg) AS average_above_status FROM site_averages AS sa JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND sa.site_avg > sta.status_avg;

WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM sites AS s LEFT JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(face_avg) AS overall_avg FROM per_site), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(face_avg) AS status_avg FROM per_site WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(p.face_avg) AS avg_kept_faces, AVG(p.face_avg - b.overall_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(p.face_avg - a.status_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM per_site AS p JOIN status_avgs AS a ON a.entrystat = p.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.face_avg > a.status_avg;

WITH race_name_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points, COUNT(*) AS field_size FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS average_field_size FROM race_name_stats) SELECT AVG(s.average_points) AS average_points, AVG(s.field_size) AS average_field_size, AVG(s.field_size - o.average_field_size) AS average_field_size_above_overall FROM race_name_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.field_size > o.average_field_size;

WITH by_name AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS avg_count FROM by_name) SELECT AVG(b.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(b.driver_count) AS avg_driver_count, AVG(b.driver_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess_count FROM by_name AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE b.driver_count > o.avg_count;

WITH counts AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_margin FROM compared WHERE share > average_share GROUP BY tradekind;

sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pair_counts), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_average_share FROM pair_shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - type_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > type_average_share GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH college_counts AS (SELECT c.college_id, CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR TRIM(c.state) = '' THEN '' ELSE c.state END AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY c.college_id, CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR TRIM(c.state) = '' THEN '' ELSE c.state END), overall AS (SELECT AVG(1.0 * player_count) AS average_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT cc.state, AVG(1.0 * cc.player_count) AS average_player_count, AVG(1.0 * cc.player_count / NULLIF(o.average_count, 0)) AS average_relative_to_overall_average, AVG(1.0 * cc.player_count / NULLIF(o.total_count, 0)) AS average_share_of_overall_total FROM college_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY cc.state

WITH college_counts AS (SELECT c.college_id, NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), '') AS state, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY c.college_id, NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT cc.state, AVG(cc.record_count) AS avg_college_count, AVG(1.0 * cc.record_count / o.avg_count) AS avg_relative_to_overall_average, AVG(1.0 * cc.record_count / o.total_count) AS avg_share_of_total FROM college_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY cc.state ORDER BY cc.state;

WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), compared AS (SELECT client_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_clients, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), compared AS (SELECT client_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_client_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_country_average FROM country_averages

sql: WITH votes AS (SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote), group_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM votes v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, ABS(avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM group_averages)) AS distance_from_group_average FROM group_averages

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_order_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e INNER JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), type_shares AS (SELECT order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM type_shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), type_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count - o.mean_pair_average) AS avg_margin FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_analyst_count > o.mean_pair_average GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_margin, avg_analyst_count / NULLIF(AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_avg_analyst_count FROM type_averages ORDER BY tradekind

sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_mean FROM pair_averages), type_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.pair_avg) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(p.pair_avg - o.overall_mean) AS avg_above_overall FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.pair_avg > o.overall_mean GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_above_overall, avg_analyst_count / NULLIF(AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_type_mean FROM type_averages;

WITH rentals_by_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_rentals FROM rentals_by_rating) SELECT AVG(rbr.rental_count) AS average_rentals_above_average, AVG(rbr.rental_count - o.average_rentals) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM rentals_by_rating AS rbr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rbr.rental_count > o.average_rentals

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS average_count, AVG(rc.rental_count - oa.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE rc.rental_count > oa.avg_count

WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN l.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND l.product_price IS NOT NULL THEN l.derived_total_cost END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND l.product_price IS NOT NULL THEN l.product_price END), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM per_invoice) SELECT AVG(p.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(p.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM per_invoice AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio
alternatives: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(l.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(l.product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM per_invoice) SELECT AVG(p.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(p.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM per_invoice AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio

sql: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS avg_invoice_ratio FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT AVG(i.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(i.invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.invoice_ratio - o.avg_invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio_excess FROM invoice_metrics AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.invoice_ratio > o.avg_invoice_ratio

WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS all_album_average FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - b.all_album_average AS above_all_album_average FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond > b.all_album_average ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Milliseconds <> 0 THEN Bytes END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0 THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS all_album_average FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - b.all_album_average AS above_all_album_average FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond > b.all_album_average ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.bytes_per_millisecond, a.bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_rate AS difference FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC, a.AlbumId LIMIT 10

WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id), total_films AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film) SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_count, ac.film_count / NULLIF(tf.film_count, 0) AS fraction_of_total, (ac.film_count - AVG(ac.film_count) OVER ()) / NULLIF(tf.film_count, 0) AS difference_from_average FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN total_films tf ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, ac.actor_id LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id) SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_count / NULLIF(SUM(film_count) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total, (film_count - AVG(film_count) OVER ()) / NULLIF(SUM(film_count) OVER (), 0) AS difference_from_average FROM actor_counts ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, actor_id LIMIT 10

sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), actor_shares AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS credit_share FROM actor_counts) SELECT actor_id, film_count, credit_share, credit_share - AVG(credit_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM actor_shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune AS order_type, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate FROM matched_fees), grouped AS (SELECT orderslink, order_type, AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS average_relative_gap FROM matched_fees GROUP BY orderslink, order_type) SELECT g.orderslink, g.order_type, g.average_rebate, g.average_relative_gap, g.average_rebate - a.average_rebate AS above_overall_average FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE g.average_rebate > a.average_rebate ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC, g.orderslink, g.order_type LIMIT 10;

WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relative_gap FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate FROM matched_fees) SELECT m.orderslink, m.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(m.rebtotal) AS average_rebate, AVG(m.relative_gap) AS average_relative_gap, AVG(m.rebtotal) - b.average_rebate AS rebate_excess FROM matched_fees AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b GROUP BY m.orderslink, m.ordertune, b.average_rebate HAVING AVG(m.rebtotal) > b.average_rebate ORDER BY rebate_excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH joined_races AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_averages AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_average_round FROM joined_races GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_average_round FROM joined_races GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_average_round, ca.circuit_average_round - coa.country_average_round AS difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS coa ON ca.country IS coa.country ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS circuit_average_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(circuit_average_round) AS country_average_round FROM circuit_averages GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_average_round, ca.circuit_average_round - coa.country_average_round AS difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS coa ON ca.country IS coa.country ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS average_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), differences AS (SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, average_round - AVG(average_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS difference FROM circuit_averages) SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, difference FROM differences ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipref, AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_mean FROM equipment_avg), above_average AS (SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity FROM equipment_avg ea CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ea.avg_humidity > o.overall_mean), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS above_group_mean FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean, a.avg_humidity - g.above_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN group_mean g WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND g.above_group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST, a.equipref LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipref, AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(humepct) AS overall_mean FROM scanenvironment), above_average AS (SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity FROM equipment_avg ea CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ea.avg_humidity > o.overall_mean), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS above_group_mean FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean, a.avg_humidity - g.above_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN group_mean g WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND g.above_group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST, a.equipref LIMIT 10

sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), all_equipment AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS reference_avg FROM equipment_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity FROM equipment_avg e CROSS JOIN all_equipment a WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.reference_avg), kept_equipment AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS reference_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.avg_humidity - a.reference_avg AS above_all_equipment_avg, ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.reference_avg) AS distance_from_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN all_equipment a CROSS JOIN kept_equipment m WHERE a.reference_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.reference_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distance_from_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH vote_shares AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.death_country), ''), '') AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max AS share FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max > 0), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(share) AS average_share FROM vote_shares GROUP BY country) SELECT country, average_share, average_share / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_share) FROM country_averages), 0) AS relative_ratio FROM country_averages ORDER BY country
alternatives: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.death_country), ''), '') AS country, AVG(CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max) AS player_share FROM player AS p JOIN player_award_vote AS v ON v.player_id = p.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max > 0 GROUP BY p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.death_country), ''), '')), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(player_share) AS average_share FROM player_averages GROUP BY country) SELECT country, average_share, average_share / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_share) FROM country_averages), 0) AS relative_ratio FROM country_averages ORDER BY country

sql: WITH votes AS (SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM manager_award_vote), player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS death_country, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS player_average FROM votes AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 GROUP BY p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '')), country_averages AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(player_average) AS country_average FROM player_averages GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, country_average, country_average / (SELECT AVG(country_average) FROM country_averages) AS relative_to_country_mean FROM country_averages

WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), with_excess AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, average_fee_rate - AVG(average_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess FROM pair_averages), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS scope_rank FROM with_excess WHERE excess > 0) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, scope_rank FROM ranked WHERE scope_rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, scope_rank, orderslink
alternatives: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), with_excess AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, average_fee_rate - AVG(average_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess FROM pair_averages), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink) AS scope_rank FROM with_excess WHERE excess > 0) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, scope_rank FROM ranked WHERE scope_rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, scope_rank

sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), eligible AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.average_fee_rate, p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank FROM eligible) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3;

WITH award_winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '') AS batting_hand FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS manager_count FROM award_winners GROUP BY batting_hand) SELECT batting_hand, manager_count, 1.0 * manager_count / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) FROM award_winners) AS share FROM hand_counts ORDER BY batting_hand

WITH color_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color, COUNT(ili.product_id) AS line_item_count FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), color_metrics AS (SELECT line_item_count, AVG(line_item_count) OVER () AS average_count_per_color, SUM(line_item_count) OVER () AS total_line_items FROM color_counts) SELECT AVG(line_item_count) AS average_count, AVG(line_item_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_line_items, 0)) AS average_share, AVG(line_item_count - average_count_per_color) AS average_excess_count FROM color_metrics WHERE line_item_count > average_count_per_color;

WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS average_payment_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(rt.payment_total - sa.average_payment_total) AS average_excess_amount FROM rental_totals AS rt JOIN store_averages AS sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.payment_total > sa.average_payment_total GROUP BY rt.store_id;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS average_invoiced_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY CASE WHEN average_invoiced_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average_invoiced_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_invoiced_quantity, average_cost_ratio, quantity_rank FROM ranked WHERE quantity_rank <= 3

WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS average_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS cross_region_mean FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.average_amount) AS mean_regional_average, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count, AVG(r.average_amount - b.cross_region_mean) AS mean_excess FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.average_amount > b.cross_region_mean;

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_per_day_price, avg_per_day_price / AVG(avg_per_day_price) OVER () AS relative_per_day_price FROM rating_averages ORDER BY rating

WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), album_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(ar.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(ar.rate - am.mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM album_rates AS ar CROSS JOIN album_mean AS am WHERE ar.rate > am.mean_rate

WITH per_event_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS overall_average FROM per_event_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.average_budgeted_amount, p.average_budgeted_amount - o.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, p.average_budgeted_amount / o.overall_average AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_event_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_budgeted_amount > o.overall_average;

WITH event_totals AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) AS total_spent, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), event_ratios AS (SELECT event_id, total_spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_amount, 0) AS spend_ratio FROM event_totals), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM event_ratios), results AS (SELECT r.event_id, r.spend_ratio, r.spend_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, relative_ratio FROM results ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), group_stats AS (SELECT invoice_count, SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(invoice_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(1.0 * invoice_count / total_count) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM group_stats WHERE invoice_count > average_count;

WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, average_unit_price - AVG(average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation FROM invoice_averages), country_deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_average FROM deviations) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, deviation_minus_country_average FROM country_deviations ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average IS NULL, deviation_minus_country_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_statuses FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_statuses) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_across_statuses;

WITH invoiced_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.gender, o.order_id FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id), gender_counts AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM invoiced_orders GROUP BY gender), gender_shares AS (SELECT gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts), compared AS (SELECT gender, order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM gender_shares) SELECT gender, order_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse_rate, a.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM first_kept), second_kept AS (SELECT k.avg_pulse_rate, k.excess_first, k.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_second FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_rate, AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_second FROM second_kept

WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.order_count) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(g.order_count - t.avg_order_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE g.order_count > t.avg_order_count;

WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), all_country_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM country_averages), above_average AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins, ca.average_wins - am.mean_wins AS excess_over_all FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_country_mean AS am WHERE ca.average_wins > am.mean_wins), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM above_average) SELECT AVG(aa.average_wins) AS mean_average_wins, AVG(aa.excess_over_all) AS mean_excess_over_all, AVG(aa.average_wins - aam.mean_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_average FROM above_average AS aa CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS aam WHERE aa.average_wins > aam.mean_wins

WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_counts AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, customer_count, AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average FROM rep_counts), kept AS (SELECT * FROM city_counts WHERE customer_count > city_average), kept_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers FROM kept) SELECT k.City AS city, SUM(k.customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(k.customer_count - k.city_average) AS average_excess, AVG(1.0 * k.customer_count / t.total_customers) AS average_share FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_total AS t GROUP BY k.City

WITH snapshots AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt, AVG(s.shortintrt) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS mix_avg_shortintrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref) SELECT transref, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(shortintrt) / NULLIF(MAX(mix_avg_shortintrt), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM snapshots GROUP BY transref, ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_line_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(lt.total_cost) AS avg_qualifying_total, COALESCE(SUM(lt.expense_count), 0) AS total_expenses, AVG(lt.total_cost - baseline.avg_line_total) AS avg_excess FROM line_totals AS lt CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE lt.total_cost > baseline.avg_line_total;

WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Track), media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.average_unit_price, m.average_unit_price / NULLIF(b.average_unit_price, 0) AS ratio FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN fielding AS f ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share, player_count - AVG(player_count) OVER () AS above_average FROM hand_counts) SELECT batting_hand, player_count, share, above_average FROM shares WHERE above_average > 0

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), ranked AS (SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS count_to_city_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY address_count DESC) AS city_rank FROM city_counts) SELECT city_id, address_count, count_to_city_average, share_of_all_addresses FROM ranked WHERE city_rank <= 10 ORDER BY city_rank, city_id

WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute - b.all_operator_avg) AS avg_margin_above_all_operator_avg FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE o.avg_gb_per_minute > b.all_operator_avg;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT bats, appearance_count, 1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM hand_counts

WITH matched AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment AS e INNER JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry) SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temperature, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_image_count, AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM matched) AS image_average_difference FROM matched GROUP BY entrystat;

WITH rates AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate;

WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), above_average AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS difference_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC) AS position FROM above_average) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference_above_average FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC, observstation;

WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.boxx) / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), ranked AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM ranked WHERE excess > 0 ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST, project_id LIMIT 10

WITH race_names AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps, COUNT(res.laps) AS laps_count FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_names) SELECT SUM(rn.total_points) AS total_points, SUM(rn.avg_laps * rn.laps_count) / NULLIF(SUM(rn.laps_count), 0) AS avg_laps, AVG(rn.total_points - t.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM race_names AS rn CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE rn.total_points > t.avg_total;

WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT sr.insurstat, AVG(sr.site_ratio) AS average_kept_ratio, SUM(sr.mesh_count) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(sr.site_ratio - sa.status_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio FROM site_ratios AS sr JOIN status_averages AS sa ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_ratio GROUP BY sr.insurstat

WITH patient_figures AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS alb_tp, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_pt FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_figures AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM patient_figures GROUP BY SEX), sex_mean AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_pt) AS mean_aptt_pt FROM sex_figures) SELECT AVG(s.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_tp, AVG(s.aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt, AVG(s.aptt_pt - m.mean_aptt_pt) AS avg_excess_aptt_pt FROM sex_figures AS s CROSS JOIN sex_mean AS m WHERE s.aptt_pt > m.mean_aptt_pt;

WITH account_volumes AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_volume, transaction_count, 1.0 * total_volume / SUM(total_volume) OVER () AS volume_share FROM account_volumes ORDER BY volume_share DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;

WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.gender) <> '' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, number_of_orders / SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS share FROM customer_orders), compared AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_gap FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, above_average_gap FROM compared WHERE above_average_gap > 0 ORDER BY above_average_gap IS NULL, above_average_gap DESC LIMIT 10

WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), overall AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.artifact_count, CAST(s.artifact_count AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(o.artifact_total, 0) AS share FROM site_totals AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.artifact_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.artifact_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
