WITH counts AS (SELECT constructorId, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, counts.record_count, counts.record_count - average_count.avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM counts JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = counts.constructorId CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE counts.record_count > average_count.avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, c.constructorId LIMIT 10

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(ra.avg_length) AS avg_rating_length, AVG(ra.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(ra.per_day_price - crm.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price FROM rating_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean AS crm WHERE ra.per_day_price > crm.mean_per_day_price;

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_got FROM Laboratory HAVING COUNT(GOT) > 0), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.overall_got AS got_difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY got_difference IS NULL, got_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH owned_accounts AS (SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id, disp.account_id FROM disp WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'), district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM owned_accounts AS oa JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oa.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS client_count FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.region, AVG(dc.client_count) AS average_clients_per_district, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / total.client_count) AS average_district_share FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN total GROUP BY dc.region

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS manager_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, manager_count, 1.0 * manager_count / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT manager_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(manager_count) AS total_managers, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), benchmarks AS (SELECT SUM(total_games) AS all_games, AVG(total_games) AS avg_team_games FROM team_totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_games, 1.0 * t.total_games / NULLIF(b.all_games, 0) AS fraction_of_all_games, 1.0 * t.total_games / NULLIF(b.avg_team_games, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM team_totals AS t CROSS JOIN benchmarks AS b ORDER BY ratio_to_average IS NULL, ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH group_rates AS (SELECT site.riskeval, AVG(scan.gbsize / NULLIF(scan.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS scan JOIN sites AS site ON site.zoneregistry = scan.zoneref GROUP BY site.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, 1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts), differences AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_above_average DESC) AS position FROM differences) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share_above_average FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, district_id;

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), account_regions AS (SELECT DISTINCT disp.account_id, district.A3 AS region FROM disp JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'), counts AS (SELECT oc.account_id, ar.region, oc.number_of_orders FROM order_counts AS oc JOIN account_regions AS ar ON ar.account_id = oc.account_id), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, number_of_orders - AVG(number_of_orders) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM counts), regional AS (SELECT *, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average_difference FROM differences) SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, difference_from_overall_average, difference_from_overall_average - region_average_difference AS excess_over_region_average FROM regional WHERE difference_from_overall_average > region_average_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status) SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(avg_remaining) / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages) AS relative_avg_remaining FROM event_averages GROUP BY status;

WITH event_rates AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(CASE WHEN b.spent <> 0 AND b.amount <> 0 THEN 1.0 * b.spent / b.amount END) AS event_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate FROM event_rates GROUP BY type) SELECT type, average_spending_rate, average_spending_rate / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_spending_rate) FROM type_rates), 0) AS relative_spending_rate FROM type_rates;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), metrics AS (SELECT analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(analysis_count) OVER () AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(analysis_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(analysis_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM metrics WHERE analysis_count > avg_count;

WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_transaction_count FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.average_amount, p.transaction_count, p.transaction_count * 1.0 / o.average_transaction_count AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH channel_counts AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS distinct_order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase) SELECT channel, average_filled_quantity, distinct_order_count, CAST(distinct_order_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(distinct_order_count) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM channel_counts

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS average_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ana) AS mean_average_ana FROM patient_averages) SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.average_ana, p.average_ana - o.mean_average_ana AS excess FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_ana > o.mean_average_ana ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), fractions AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, examination_count * 1.0 / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM group_counts), average_fraction AS (SELECT AVG(fraction) AS value FROM fractions) SELECT f.ID, f.examination_count, f.fraction, f.fraction - a.value AS excess FROM fractions AS f CROSS JOIN average_fraction AS a WHERE f.fraction > a.value ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(f.orderslink AS text) = CAST(o.recordvault AS text)), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS rate FROM matched), pair_rates AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS rate FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(p.rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.rate - b.rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark FROM pair_rates AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.rate IS NOT NULL AND p.rate > b.rate;

WITH channel_rates AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE o.orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS rate FROM channel_rates) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.rate) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.rate

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN client AS c ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS region_share, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(SUM(client_count) OVER (), 0) AS overall_share FROM district_counts ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, rental_count / SUM(rental_count) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), compared_shares AS (SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_ratings FROM rating_shares) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_ratings) AS average_excess_share FROM compared_shares WHERE share > average_share_across_ratings

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(sc.player_count) AS average_count, AVG(sc.player_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM state_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sc.player_count > o.average_count;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall_avg FROM patient_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_avg FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_kept_hgb FROM kept) SELECT k.ID, k.avg_hgb, k.avg_hgb - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_hgb - m.mean_kept_hgb AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, CAST(order_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(order_count AS NUMERIC) / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY acctscope;

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oa.avg_count FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.order_count - k.avg_count AS above_overall_average, k.order_count - ka.avg_count AS above_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_avg AS ka ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC, k.account_id LIMIT 10;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT status, project_count, CAST(project_count AS numeric) / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT status, project_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT status, project_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH by_status AS (SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(NULLIF(oe.fillcount, 0)) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow) SELECT status, average_filled_quantity, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions FROM by_status

WITH grouped AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS group_amount FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT group_amount, 1.0 * group_amount / SUM(group_amount) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), compared AS (SELECT group_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(group_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH frequency_averages AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount FROM frequency_averages) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(f.avg_balance) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.avg_signed_amount - m.mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess FROM frequency_averages AS f CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE f.avg_signed_amount > m.mean_signed_amount;

WITH execution_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS benchmark FROM orderexecutions), order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS order_avg FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_pass AS (SELECT oa.order_avg, eb.benchmark FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN execution_benchmark eb WHERE oa.order_avg > eb.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(order_avg) AS benchmark FROM first_pass) SELECT AVG(fp.order_avg) AS average_unfilled_quantity, AVG(fp.order_avg - fp.benchmark) AS average_excess_over_first_benchmark, AVG(fp.order_avg - sb.benchmark) AS average_excess_over_second_benchmark FROM first_pass fp CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb WHERE fp.order_avg > sb.benchmark;
SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM account GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS avg_share_pct FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - avg_share_pct) AS average_excess_pct FROM compared WHERE share_pct > avg_share_pct;

SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_members FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY fraction_of_members DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(1.0 * HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS average_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio

SELECT CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END AS state, COUNT(*) AS matched_records, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS share_of_all_records FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_model_confidence FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS value FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_model_confidence, b.value AS baseline_value FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.avg_model_confidence > b.value), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_model_confidence) AS value FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_model_confidence, q.avg_model_confidence - q.baseline_value AS difference_from_baseline, q.avg_model_confidence / m.value AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m WHERE q.baseline_value IS NOT NULL AND m.value IS NOT NULL

WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_stats) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.byte_rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_stats AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.byte_rate > b.avg_rate

WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_rates) AS relative_rate FROM media_rates

WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), first_pass AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - fa.avg_count AS excess_first FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN first_average fa WHERE ac.actor_count > fa.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM first_pass) SELECT SUM(fp.actor_count) AS total_actor_count, AVG(fp.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(fp.actor_count - sa.avg_count) AS avg_excess_second FROM first_pass fp CROSS JOIN second_average sa WHERE fp.actor_count > sa.avg_count

WITH counts AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position), shares AS (SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendance_count DESC) AS attendance_rank FROM counts) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share FROM shares WHERE attendance_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, member_id;
SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS race_share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId ORDER BY race_share DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_spent_ratio, ABS(avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER ()) AS distance_from_mean FROM per_type

WITH type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM type_rates) SELECT tr.Name, tr.rate, tr.track_count, tr.rate - mr.rate AS rate_above_mean FROM type_rates AS tr CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr WHERE tr.rate > mr.rate;

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS film_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.film_count) AS total_films, AVG(rc.film_count - ra.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.film_count > ra.avg_count

WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), all_statuses AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(sr.rate - a.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a WHERE sr.rate > a.average_rate

WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' OR p.SEX IS NULL GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT AVG(test_count) AS avg_count, SUM(test_count) AS total_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT s.sex, s.test_count, CAST(s.test_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS fraction_of_total, s.test_count - t.avg_count AS above_average FROM sex_counts AS s CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE s.test_count > t.avg_count;

WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), ranked AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY telescope_count DESC) AS station_rank FROM station_counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share FROM ranked WHERE station_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, observstation;

WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS side_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.dealedge), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(side_count) AS average_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.side_count) AS total_count, AVG(sc.side_count - sa.average_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa WHERE sc.side_count > sa.average_count;

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_figures AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS average_figure FROM region_figures), above_average AS (SELECT r.region, r.figure, o.average_figure FROM region_figures AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.figure > o.average_figure) SELECT region, figure, figure - average_figure AS excess, figure / (SELECT AVG(figure) FROM above_average) AS ratio_to_above_average FROM above_average ORDER BY region;

SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat

WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM winners GROUP BY batting_hand), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, player_count, CAST(player_count AS REAL) / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), hand_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.batting_hand, s.player_count, s.share, s.share - h.average_share AS above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN hand_average AS h WHERE s.share > h.average_share;

WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), all_colleges AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT AVG(c.record_count) AS average_count, AVG(c.record_count * 1.0 / a.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.record_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM college_counts AS c CROSS JOIN all_colleges AS a WHERE c.record_count > a.average_count;

WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), shares AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share FROM invoice_counts), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - t.average_share) AS average_excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE s.share > t.average_share;

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_account_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) AS mean_region_amount FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.avg_account_amount, r.avg_account_balance, r.avg_account_amount / o.mean_region_amount AS amount_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_region_amount IS NOT NULL

WITH per_player AS (SELECT b.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b.double) AS average_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS b JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, average_doubles / (SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM per_player) AS index_value FROM per_player), compared AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, index_value, index_value - AVG(index_value) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, index_value, difference FROM compared WHERE bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC, player_id LIMIT 10;

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS account_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_averages AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(account_average) AS frequency_average FROM account_averages GROUP BY frequency), results AS (SELECT aa.account_id, aa.frequency, aa.account_average, aa.account_average / NULLIF(fa.frequency_average, 0) AS ratio FROM account_averages AS aa JOIN frequency_averages AS fa ON fa.frequency = aa.frequency) SELECT account_id, frequency, account_average, ratio FROM results ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH source_averages AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, AVG(s.aream2 / NULLIF(s.volm3, 0)) AS area_to_volume FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_area_to_volume FROM source_averages) SELECT a.fundflux, a.avg_y_vs_x_difference, a.area_to_volume, a.area_to_volume - c.avg_area_to_volume AS above_cross_source_average FROM source_averages AS a CROSS JOIN cross_source AS c WHERE a.area_to_volume > c.avg_area_to_volume
SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendance_entries, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proportion FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT site_count, site_count::numeric / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT site_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(site_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS baseline_quantity FROM order_averages) SELECT o.order_id, o.average_quantity, o.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.baseline_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity) IS NULL, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH station_stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / SUM(SUM(telescope_count)) OVER () AS telescope_fraction FROM station_stats GROUP BY lunarstage

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, number_of_orders - (SELECT AVG(number_of_orders) FROM order_counts) AS difference_from_average FROM order_counts ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating HAVING COUNT(length) > 0), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS baseline_length FROM rating_averages), above_baseline AS (SELECT ra.avg_length FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ra.avg_length > b.baseline_length), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS kept_avg_length FROM above_baseline) SELECT AVG(ab.avg_length) AS mean_length, AVG(ab.avg_length - b.baseline_length) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(ab.avg_length - km.kept_avg_length) AS mean_above_kept_mean FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE ab.avg_length > km.kept_avg_length;

WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH item_averages AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_averages GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - x.avg_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM town_averages AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.avg_ratio > x.avg_ratio

WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(m.byte_rate - o.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.byte_rate > o.avg_rate;

WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, 1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(ReportsTo AS TEXT), '') AS ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM shares ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, ReportsTo ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.tradekind, c.transaction_count, c.transaction_count::numeric / s.total_count AS share_of_total, c.transaction_count - s.average_count AS count_above_average FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS s WHERE s.average_count IS NOT NULL AND c.transaction_count > s.average_count;

SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, s.insurstat NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS across_rating_average FROM rating_prices) SELECT AVG(rp.per_day_price) AS average_per_day_price, AVG(rp.per_day_price - ra.across_rating_average) AS average_excess FROM rating_prices rp CROSS JOIN rating_average ra WHERE rp.per_day_price > ra.across_rating_average

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), counts_with_average AS (SELECT order_count, AVG(order_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_order_count, AVG(order_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM counts_with_average WHERE order_count > average_count;

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), with_baseline AS (SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS baseline FROM status_averages), kept AS (SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, baseline FROM with_baseline WHERE avg_modindex > baseline) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - baseline AS above_baseline, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept

WITH matched AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), time_in_force_averages AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS time_in_force_average FROM matched GROUP BY timespan), order_averages AS (SELECT orderspivot, ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS order_average_fill FROM matched GROUP BY orderspivot, ordersmark, timespan), ranked AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.timespan, oa.order_average_fill, oa.order_average_fill - ta.time_in_force_average AS excess_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oa.timespan ORDER BY oa.order_average_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM order_averages AS oa JOIN time_in_force_averages AS ta ON oa.timespan IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ta.timespan WHERE oa.order_average_fill > ta.time_in_force_average) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_average_fill, excess_fill, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE fill_rank <= 3

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '')), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(h.player_count) AS total_count, AVG(h.share) AS average_share, AVG(h.share - a.share) AS average_excess FROM hand_shares AS h CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE h.share > a.share;

WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_members, member_count / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS count_to_average_ratio FROM major_counts ORDER BY count_to_average_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM sex_averages) AS ana_ratio FROM sex_averages

WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM circuit_counts), compared AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - average_share AS excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY excess_share DESC, circuitId LIMIT 10

WITH standings_with_previous AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, ds.wins, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId) AS standing_number, LAG(ds.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId) AS previous_wins FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL), race_averages AS (SELECT country, raceId, AVG(wins - CASE WHEN standing_number = 1 THEN 0 ELSE previous_wins END) AS race_average FROM standings_with_previous GROUP BY country, raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_average) AS country_average FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS overall_average FROM country_averages), above_benchmark AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_average, b.overall_average FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ca.country_average > b.overall_average), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS second_average FROM above_benchmark) SELECT a.country, a.country_average AS average, a.country_average - a.overall_average AS above_overall_benchmark, a.country_average - s.second_average AS above_second_mean FROM above_benchmark AS a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS s WHERE a.country_average > s.second_average ORDER BY a.country;

WITH units AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), mix_baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units GROUP BY ordertypedist), overall_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units) SELECT AVG(u.ownership) AS average_ownership, AVG(u.ownership / NULLIF(m.baseline, 0)) AS average_relative_to_mix, AVG(u.ownership - o.baseline) AS average_excess_ownership FROM units AS u JOIN mix_baselines AS m ON m.ordertypedist = u.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN overall_baseline AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.baseline;

WITH counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share_difference FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC) AS position FROM compared WHERE share_difference > 0) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC;

WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT shares.department, shares.member_count, shares.share, shares.share - average_share.share AS share_minus_average FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE shares.share >= average_share.share

WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count, AVG(g.invoice_count - a.avg_invoice_count) AS avg_excess FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE g.invoice_count > a.avg_invoice_count;

SELECT rating, avg_ratio, film_count, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_rating_average FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS rating_summary ORDER BY rating

WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc AS q INNER JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count::numeric / AVG(qc_count::numeric) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM funding_counts ORDER BY fundflux NULLS LAST;

WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT "telescref", AVG("modindex") AS avg_modindex FROM "signals" WHERE "modindex" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "telescref"), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t."telescref", t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, t.avg_modindex / NULLIF(o.overall_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC, t."telescref" ASC LIMIT 10

WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS baseline_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT c.*, c.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_avg AS deviation FROM combinations AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations AS d) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM compared WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind

WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute_rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT r.status, r.total_scan_count, r.gb_per_minute_rate, r.gb_per_minute_rate - b.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.gb_per_minute_rate > b.average_rate

WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count FROM film AS f JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count, copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS difference_from_rating_average, copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM film_copies ORDER BY difference_from_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS units FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, units, 1.0 * units / NULLIF(SUM(units) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_units), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(p.units) AS combined_units, AVG(p.share) AS average_share, AVG(p.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM product_shares AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.share > o.average_share

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behaviour_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), type_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behaviour_count, behaviour_count::numeric / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, behaviour_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM type_shares) SELECT tradekind, behaviour_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share;

WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS rate FROM per_order) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate, AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.rate) AS avg_excess_net_fee_rate FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.rate

SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment AS p WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.staff_id ORDER BY p.staff_id

WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), shares AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM project_counts), deviations AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST) AS deviation_rank FROM deviations) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation FROM ranked WHERE deviation_rank <= 10 ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST, arcref;

WITH linked AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM linked), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_modindex) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(g.avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(g.avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_baseline FROM telescope_weather AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex GROUP BY g.weathprofile;

WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS ratio_average FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY p.SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_average) AS value FROM sex_averages), above_first AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.ratio_average FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE s.ratio_average > f.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_average) AS value FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.ratio_average) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.ratio_average - f.value) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(a.ratio_average - m.value) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE a.ratio_average > m.value

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), regional_counts AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM district_counts), above_average AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, region_avg FROM regional_counts WHERE account_count > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS exceeds_region_avg, account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio FROM above_average ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH scope_fees AS (SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_record_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_scope_average FROM scope_fees

WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), bucket_shares AS (SELECT bucket_count, bucket_count::numeric / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share FROM bucket_counts), compared AS (SELECT bucket_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS all_bucket_average FROM bucket_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bucket_count) FILTER (WHERE share > all_bucket_average), 0) AS total_count, AVG(share) FILTER (WHERE share > all_bucket_average) AS average_share, AVG(share - all_bucket_average) FILTER (WHERE share > all_bucket_average) AS average_excess FROM compared;

WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM telescope_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS avg_share_pct FROM shares) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share_pct) AS avg_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - avg_share_pct) AS avg_excess_share_pct FROM compared WHERE share_pct > avg_share_pct;

WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS state_total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT state_total, 1.0 * state_total / NULLIF(SUM(state_total) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_totals), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.state_total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM state_shares s CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE s.share > b.average_share

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating AS (SELECT AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(r.daily_price - c.avg_daily_price) AS avg_excess_daily_price FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN cross_rating AS c WHERE r.daily_price > c.avg_daily_price

WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT account_count, 1.0 * account_count / NULLIF(SUM(account_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.account_count) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM state_shares AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.share > o.average_share;

WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_stats AS (SELECT player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(1.0 * player_count) OVER () AS overall_average FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_player_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(player_count - overall_average) AS average_excess FROM country_stats WHERE player_count > overall_average

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), ranked AS (SELECT city_id, address_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY address_count DESC) AS city_rank FROM city_counts) SELECT city_id, address_count, CAST(address_count AS DECIMAL(30,20)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction FROM ranked WHERE city_rank <= 10 ORDER BY address_count DESC, city_id;

WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behaviour_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behaviour_count, behaviour_count::numeric / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () AS share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(behaviour_count) AS average_count_per_pair, AVG(share) AS average_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS mean_iga_igm FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm) AS avg_patient_iga_igm, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm / NULLIF(o.mean_iga_igm, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY pa.SEX;

WITH per_driver AS (SELECT d.driverId, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_count * 1.0) AS value FROM per_driver) SELECT p.driverId, p.qualifying_count, p.qualifying_count * 1.0 / a.value AS ratio FROM per_driver AS p CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE p.qualifying_count > 0 ORDER BY ratio DESC, p.driverId LIMIT 10;

WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), scored AS (SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, AVG(spatial_count) OVER () AS average_count, SUM(spatial_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, spatial_count::numeric / total_count AS share, spatial_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM scored WHERE spatial_count > average_count;

WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_amount FROM account_averages) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - m.mean_amount AS amount_above_mean FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE a.average_amount > m.mean_amount ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount, 1.0 * SUM(i.amount) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income), 0) AS fraction_of_all_income FROM income AS i JOIN member AS mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major AS m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college;

WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), group_shares AS (SELECT record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), compared AS (SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM group_shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share

WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(product_quantity) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) END) AS average_quantity, AVG(1.0 * (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH department_counts AS (SELECT ma.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), department_shares AS (SELECT income_count, income_count * 1.0 / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT income_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM department_shares) SELECT SUM(income_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_kept AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_excess FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_kept), final_orders AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.first_excess, f.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS second_excess FROM first_kept f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE f.avg_fill > b.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS average_fill_quantity, AVG(first_excess) AS average_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS average_second_excess FROM final_orders;

WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT SUM(patient_count) AS combined_count, AVG(patient_count) AS average_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.patient_count) AS total_count, AVG(1.0 * sc.patient_count / t.combined_count) AS average_share, AVG(sc.patient_count - t.average_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE sc.patient_count > t.average_count;
SELECT i.film_id, COUNT(*) AS copy_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_copies FROM inventory AS i GROUP BY i.film_id ORDER BY share_of_copies DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT timespan, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan;

WITH account_orders AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 * order_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) END AS share FROM account_orders), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.order_count), 0) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value;

WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), product_shares AS (SELECT product_type_description, avg_quantity, item_count, 1.0 * item_count / SUM(item_count) OVER () AS item_share FROM product_stats), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_share FROM product_shares GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(avg_item_count) AS average_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share) AS average_share FROM type_stats

WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, 1.0 * SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios), results AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_item_count, relative_ratio FROM results ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT b.link_to_event, AVG(b.spent) AS average_spent, AVG(b.remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(b.remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS remaining_difference FROM budget AS b WHERE b.link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.link_to_event ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH site_groups AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, g.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(m.mean_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m WHERE m.mean_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN average_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average_ratio DESC) AS event_rank FROM event_averages) SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank FROM ranked WHERE event_rank <= 3;

WITH per_currency AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(NULLIF(rebtotal, 0)) AS avg_rebate, AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0) END) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_rebate FROM per_currency) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate, AVG(p.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(p.avg_rebate - b.mean_rebate) AS avg_excess_rebate FROM per_currency AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_rebate > b.mean_rebate;

WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_difference FROM budget), status_averages AS (SELECT event_status AS status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_difference FROM budget GROUP BY event_status) SELECT s.status, s.avg_difference AS average, s.avg_difference - b.avg_difference AS difference_from_baseline FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.avg_difference IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_difference IS NOT NULL

WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.avg_anlycount FROM transaction_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - ko.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_overall ko ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId) THEN r.raceId END) AS race_count FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / NULLIF(SUM(race_count) OVER (), 0) AS share, COUNT(*) OVER () AS city_count FROM city_counts) SELECT city, race_count, share, share - 1.0 / city_count AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > 1.0 / city_count ORDER BY share DESC, city

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages)

WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS station_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg) AS avg_kept_bandwidth, SUM(p.station_count) AS total_station_counts, AVG(p.phase_avg - m.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS m WHERE p.phase_avg > m.mean_phase_avg;

WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS average_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, average_points, average_wins, average_wins - (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_difference FROM country_averages ORDER BY country;

WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), scored AS (SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1e0 / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city), 0) AS town_share, transaction_count * 1e0 / NULLIF(AVG(transaction_count * 1e0) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, town_share, ratio_to_average FROM scored ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(l.HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.avg_wbc, pa.ratio, pa.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH major_counts AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, g.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS g ON m.link_to_major = g.major_id GROUP BY m.link_to_major, g.department), shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share FROM major_counts), compared AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS difference FROM shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, difference FROM compared WHERE difference > 0 ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM station_averages) SELECT AVG(sa.station_avg) AS mean_station_average, AVG(sa.station_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM station_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_avg;

WITH telescope_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS rate FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_avgs AS t CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > b.rate), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS rate FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b1.rate) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - b2.rate) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b1 CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS b2 WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > b2.rate;

WITH event_counts AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), shares AS (SELECT event_id, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM event_counts), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST) AS share_rank FROM shares) SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, event_id;

WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM execution_counts), differences AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM differences) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST, ordersmark NULLS LAST;

WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, total_spent, 1.0 * total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_totals), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.total_spent) AS average_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG((s.share - b.average_share) / NULLIF(b.average_share, 0)) AS average_relative_difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share

WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, CAST(feature_count AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM site_totals), compared AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10

WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference FROM shares ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), ranked AS (SELECT race_counts.*, AVG(entry_count) OVER () AS average_entry_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY entry_count DESC) AS entry_rank FROM race_counts) SELECT raceId, country, total_points, entry_count, entry_count - average_entry_count AS difference_above_average FROM ranked WHERE entry_count > average_entry_count AND entry_rank <= 10 ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC, raceId;

WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG(1.0 * (spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(c.avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(c.line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(c.line_count - o.avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count FROM category_stats AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.line_count > o.avg_line_count;
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_share IS NULL, order_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, 1.0 * SUM(w) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT year), 0) AS average_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS average_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average_wins FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.average_wins, t.average_games_minus_losses_per_loss, t.average_wins - o.mean_average_wins AS gap FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.average_wins > o.mean_average_wins ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(s.member_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - o.average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_average FROM city_shares AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.share > o.average_share;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) AS mean_igm FROM patient_averages), deviations AS (SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.acl_igm, pa.acl_igm - om.mean_igm AS deviation FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS mean_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX), results AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.mean_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.mean_deviation) SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation, excess FROM results ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST, ID LIMIT 10;

WITH group_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg FROM Examination GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_avg FROM group_averages), kept AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_acl_igg, g.avg_acl_igg - o.mean_avg AS above_overall_mean FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE g.avg_acl_igg > o.mean_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_acl_igg, k.above_overall_mean, ABS(k.avg_acl_igg - m.mean_avg) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m;

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget), event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_avg FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), kept AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.event_avg FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.event_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) AS mean_kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.event_avg, k.event_avg - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.event_avg - m.mean_kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS avg_project_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(ss.project_count) AS total_distinct_projects, AVG(ss.project_count - b.avg_project_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ss.project_count > b.avg_project_count

WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL THEN a.g_1b - a.g_cf END), 0) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM player_totals) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(t.total - o.avg_total) AS average_excess FROM player_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.total > o.avg_total

WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), timing_groups AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS mean_group_avg, AVG(g.group_avg - b.overall_avg) AS mean_excess FROM timing_groups AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.group_avg > b.overall_avg

WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id) SELECT store_id, active_customers, active_customers / SUM(active_customers) OVER () AS share_of_total, active_customers / AVG(active_customers) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM store_counts ORDER BY store_id
