WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts ORDER BY tradekind

WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM station_averages) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.avg_bandwidth_usage AS above_overall_average FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.avg_bandwidth_usage ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), major_shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), compared AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM major_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(member_count), 0) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share

WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.constructorId) AS constructor_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_count, constructor_count - AVG(constructor_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;

WITH category_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(NULLIF(TRIM(ili.product_quantity), '')) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), category_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference FROM category_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference) AS average_cost_difference, AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference - cm.mean_cost_difference) AS average_excess FROM category_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm WHERE ca.avg_cost_difference > cm.mean_cost_difference;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.riskeval), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, scan_count::numeric / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS scan_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scan_count DESC) AS position FROM grouped) SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, average_compression_ratio, scan_count, scan_share FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY scan_share DESC, site_code, risk_evaluation_status;

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS overall_average FROM type_averages HAVING AVG(type_average) IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT t.type_average FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_average > b.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS average_of_kept FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.type_average, b.overall_average, m.average_of_kept FROM kept k CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.type_average > m.average_of_kept) SELECT AVG(r.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(r.type_average - r.overall_average) AS average_above_baseline, AVG(r.type_average - r.average_of_kept) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b LEFT JOIN remaining r ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY b.overall_average

WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), ranked AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, CAST(signal_count AS REAL) / SUM(signal_count) OVER () AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) AS signal_rank FROM telescope_counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE signal_rank <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, telescref;

WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS behaviour_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behaviour_count, behaviour_count::numeric / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), compared AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behaviour_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share FROM mix_shares) SELECT order_type_mix, behaviour_count, share, share - baseline_share AS above_baseline FROM compared WHERE share > baseline_share

WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.rate AS excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio FROM patient_ratios AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_above_overall, AVG(a.ratio - s.average_ratio) AS average_above_second FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE a.ratio > s.average_ratio

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_ownership_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS avg_event_difference FROM event_averages) SELECT e.event_type, e.avg_analyst_reports, e.avg_ownership_difference, e.avg_ownership_difference - o.avg_event_difference AS difference_from_overall FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.avg_event_difference IS NOT NULL;

WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, m.facetfaces FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), site_averages AS (SELECT zoneregistry, entrystat, AVG(facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM matched GROUP BY zoneregistry, entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM matched), status_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces FROM site_averages WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(sa.avg_faces) AS avg_kept_faces, AVG(sa.avg_faces - b.avg_faces) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(sa.avg_faces - sta.avg_faces) AS avg_above_status FROM site_averages AS sa JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.avg_faces IS NOT NULL AND sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_faces;

WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS standing_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(standing_count) AS avg_count FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS average_points, AVG(p.standing_count) AS average_count, AVG(p.standing_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess_count FROM per_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.standing_count > o.avg_count;

WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pair_counts), compared AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS average_type_share FROM pair_shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_type_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share >= average_type_share GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH college_counts AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), ''), '') AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), ''), '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT cc.state, AVG(cc.player_count) AS avg_player_count, AVG(cc.player_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.avg_count, 0)) AS avg_relative_to_overall_average, AVG(cc.player_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.total_count, 0)) AS avg_share_of_total FROM college_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY cc.state;

WITH account_links AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_id, account_id FROM disp), region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM account_links AS al JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = al.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) AS total_count, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - b.average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM region_shares AS rs CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE rs.share > b.average_share

WITH group_averages AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR p.death_country = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.death_country END AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR p.death_country = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.death_country END), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) AS mean_group_average FROM group_averages) SELECT g.death_country, g.avg_points_won, ABS(g.avg_points_won - o.mean_group_average) AS distance_from_mean_group_average FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o

WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT execution_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS total_execution_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share

WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), type_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count - o.mean_pair_average) AS avg_above_overall_mean FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE p.avg_analyst_count > o.mean_pair_average GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_above_overall_mean, avg_analyst_count / NULLIF(AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_type_mean FROM type_averages;

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rental_id IS NOT NULL THEN f.film_id END) AS film_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.film_count) AS average_film_count, AVG(rc.film_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rc.film_count > o.avg_count;

WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT AVG(i.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(i.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_excess FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.bytes_per_millisecond, a.bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_rate AS rate_difference FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY rate_difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), film_total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS total_films FROM film_actor), shares AS (SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_count, ac.film_count / ft.total_films AS film_share FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN film_total ft) SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_share, film_share - AVG(film_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, actor_id LIMIT 10

WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS average_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS average_relative_gap FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_rebate) AS average_rebate FROM fee_groups) SELECT g.orderslink, g.order_type, g.average_rebate, g.average_relative_gap, g.average_rebate - b.average_rebate AS rebate_excess FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.average_rebate > b.average_rebate ORDER BY rebate_excess DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH race_circuits AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_averages AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS average_round FROM race_circuits GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS baseline_round FROM race_circuits GROUP BY country), differences AS (SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.average_round, ca.average_round - co.baseline_round AS round_difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country IS co.country) SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, round_difference FROM differences ORDER BY round_difference IS NULL, round_difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg FROM equipment_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), compared AS (SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, overall_avg, AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, avg_humidity - overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, ABS(avg_humidity - kept_avg) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM compared WHERE kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

WITH vote_ratios AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max AS ratio FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM vote_ratios GROUP BY country) SELECT country, average_ratio, average_ratio / AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS relative_to_country_mean FROM country_averages

WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), ranked AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.average_fee_rate, p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.acctscope ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average DESC, p.orderslink ASC) AS rank FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank;
